description.zh: 每週三小時一學分的專業必修課，旨在教導碩一新生學習各種生化工程相關的實驗原理與操作技術，以增進學生在未來進行生化實驗研究的知識與技巧；此外，課程中安排工廠參觀實習，結合學術與產業，豐富學生視野，促進學生對產業界的瞭解。
description.en: The three-hour per week course is designed to teach the 1st year graduate students a variety of biochemical engineering principles and hands-on skills to strengthen their knowledge and skills of the field; The course comes with 1-2 visits to industrial plants to further enrich the students' understanding of the industrial process.

description.zh: 利用基因工程，生物化學、微生物學之原理，培養變種之微生物（或改良過的微生物），動、植物細胞，以製造生物活性物質（如抗生素、免疫體、酵素、毒素、激素、特殊結構之蛋白、脂肪、醣類、脂肪酸、氨基酸、生長因子、藥理活性成份、抗體等等）；結合生物技術與化工原理來進行微生物、動、植物細胞之培養、酵素之提取、反應動力學、生物反應器的操作與相關參考數之獲取法、產品之分離程序等。
description.en: By the application of genetic engineering, biochemistry and microorganisms or animal or plant cells and how to produce living organisms. In combination of biotechnology and chemical engineering to learn cell incubation, enzyme purification, bioreactor operation, and product separation, etc.

description.zh: 本課程介紹應用於醫療器材、人工器官、組織工程以及藥物釋放的相關材料。醫療器材主要包含骨科器材、人工關節、生物晶片、材料表面處理。人工器官包含人工軟骨、人工血管、人工皮膚、人工肝臟等。組織工程包含支架材料、生物可分解性材料、生物反應器。藥物釋放包含高分子薄膜及目標型藥物傳送等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to illustrate the concepts about medical devices, artificial organs, tissue engineering and drug release technologies. The fundamentals of biomaterials will be introduced including materials, surface treatment, biological interactions, mechanical properties.

notes: 網路預選限 80 人；化工所生化所合開

description.zh: 「仿生工程」是生物學到工程技術的觀念轉移，生物系統在上億年的演化驗證後已經達到高效且永續的精緻成果，本課程將介紹仿生工程之最新發展，師法自然將其應用於工程上將帶來革命性的突破。課程內容包含四大主題: (1) 仿生概述、(2) 生物製造技術、(3) 生物高分子與 (4) 生物材料於仿生技術上的應用。
description.en: “Biomimetic Engineering” is a kind of knowledge transferring from biology to engineering technology. After billions of years of evolution, it has been proven that the biological system is highly efficient and sustainable. In this course, the latest progress in Biomimetic Engineering will be introduced. It will bring us revolutionary breakthroughs if we learn from nature and apply it to technology. The topics covered in this course will include (1) an introduction to bioinspiration, (2) biofabrication, (3) biomacromolecules, and (4) biomaterials and their application in bioinspired engineering.

notes: 生化所和化工所合開

description.zh: 本課程的目的是提升學生的科技英文技能和協助他們進階職場的實用英語需求。此課程著重於科技英語之閱讀、聽力、口語、寫作、理解、語法規則、詞彙，發音，對話，商務溝通，和專業演講技巧。本課程包括撰寫履歷，面試技巧，軟技能如溝通技巧，職場禮節；email 及電話技巧，出差英語，判斷力，了解國際科技職場環境及工作需求，專業項目策劃及執行。輔導學生如何展現自己優勢及作好個人職業規劃，從而順利邁向成功目標.
description.en: This course aims to educate students in Information Technology English and prepare students for their career advancement. This course focuses on IT science and technology English reading, listening, speaking, writing, comprehension, grammar rules, vocabulary, pronunciation, conversation, communication, and professional presentation skills. This course also covers soft skills such as interview tips, communication, business etiquette, travel English, email English, decision making, understanding international business, global working environment, project management planning and execution. In addition, this course offers personal development for students to discover their personal advantage and perform their career planning for achieving career goals.

The course is not only to teach students to interpret spectra, but also to present basic theoretical concepts.

The contents include optimisation theory and algorithms, mathematical programming and modelling techniques, and applications to chemical engineering problems and energy issues.

description.zh: 主要應用於噴射引擎、氣渦輪機、石化工業、高溫爐、焚化爐、及核能反應器等各方面，目前愈來愈重要，深受注目，主要材料包括    耐熱鋼、鐵基、鎳基、鉻基超合金、介金屬化合物、分散強化型合金及瓷金等，課程內容主要介紹各種材料合金的化學組成，製程， 各項性質及其應用等。
description.en: introduction to superalloys

description.zh: 本課程目的在了解「為何」與「如何」以電腦模擬方式進行材料科學研究。課程內容提及量子化學、固態物理與密度泛函理論 (DFT)。而後將實際演練基本的材料模擬計算，內容包括結構最佳化、電子性質、光學性質、機械性質等，並將透過 Python 進行資料處理。學生可透過此課程學到材料模擬的基本原理、工作流程與實際操作，得以以理論觀點 / 微觀尺度評估材料議題。
description.en: The main purpose of the course is to understand “why to do” and “how to do” researches in materials science by using computer simulations. The background theory of quantum chemistry, solid-state physics and density functional theory (DFT) will be briefly introduced. The common tasks of materials simulations, including structural optimizations, electronic properties, optical properties, mechanical properties, etc., will be then demonstrated and employed. Basic commands of Python will also be introduced in doing data processing for analyses. Students will learn about basic principles, workflows and practices of materials simulations, being capable to evaluate materials’ issues from theoretical and microscopic viewpoints.

notes: 計網電腦教室

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case Study. Seminar. Group meeting.

notes: 限碩士班修讀

description.zh: 本課程著重於資源再生分選廠的設計與規劃，如何選擇各項機械，並利用電腦程式輔助以達成建廠設計的知識。
description.en: The objective of this class is to teach student how to design a process plant to conduct industrial waste recycling and reutilization.  The process unit selection and computer modeling and simulation will also be included in the design process.

description.zh: 此課程將介紹各種實驗之配置法及統計分析方法和結論，包括一因子、二因子、多因子實驗、完全隨機化法、及直交表、田口式品質工程。以提升實驗效率及品質。
description.en: This course aim to provide students with methods of promoting experimental efficiency. It may include introduction to basic statistical concepts, one-factor experiment, two-factor experiment, multi-factor experiments, completely randomized design, randomized and orthogonal array, Taguchi technique for quality engineering.

description.zh: 主要內容包含：企業研究的本質、研究流程、研究問題與假設、文獻評論、資料收集、操作性定義、測量、理論架構模型化、研究設計、量化與質化研究、個案研究法、資料分析與解釋、研究報告撰寫。
description.en: The course mainly discusses concepts of business research methods. The contents will include following topics：（1）the nature of business research, （2）elements of research and research process, （3）research problem and hypothesis,（4）literature review, （5）research design, （6）research proposal, （7）case study, （8）analysis and the interpretation of data, （9）quantitative and qualitative research,(10) research report.

notes: 計網電腦教室

description.zh: 本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。目的二，進一步教授 ESG 及聯合國 SDGs 指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。最後，透過對於 ESG 與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

notes: 經管所和 IMBA 合開

description.zh: 針對學生之學習研究心得報告，集體討論，以訓練學生研究之能力。
description.en: Group Discussion.

description.zh: 本課程介紹管理會計和控制等之成本會計概念介紹，本課程之目的在了解管理會計之實務與應用內涵，並藉以設計及發展管理資訊系統另外，本課程也針對與管會相關之介紹 (just-in-time, balanced scorecards, profitability center, investment center … 等) 與管理決策 (外包或自製，增加產品線，績效評估… 等)
description.en: This course deals with management accounting and control both within a micro-behavioural and within an organisational theory perspective. The aim is to provide an understanding of the developments in management accounting and control theory and practice and the implications of critical variables that affect the design, development and operation of management accounting and control systems. Practical aspects of management accounting are mainly examined through computer assisted learning (CAL). Students are expected to cover the prescribed reading on their own, and to perceive the taught seminars as the opportunity to ask questions and to offer their views at any time.

notes: 經管所和 IMBA 合開

description.zh: 本課程的目的是幫助學生在 21 世紀準備行銷業務並為之做出貢獻。無論是打算在企業、政府還是非營利組織工作，有效營銷的概念、策略和技術都是相關的。本課程是：從基本概念到與營銷相關，再到營銷在組織中的策略運用；儘早關注營銷的全球性。強調消費者營銷和企業營銷之間的相同點和不同點。將需求預測與其市場區隔、目標定位和市場定位相結合，在接觸消費者和商業市場以及市場區格之後，涵蓋市場營銷研究。在學生掌握市場營銷的含義後，整合規劃、實施和評估以提供眾向的行銷策略。
description.en: The purpose of this course is try to help students prepare to operate in and contribute to the 21st century. Regardless of whether a person intends to work in a business, for the government, or in a nonprofit organization, the concepts, strategies, and techniques of effective marketing are relevant. This course is:Providing from fundamental concepts through the major tasks associated with marketing to the strategic role of marketing in an organization.Bringing early attention to the global nature of marketing.Emphasizing the similarities as well as the differences between consumer and business marketing.Combining demand forecasting with its logical antecedents-segmentation, targeting, and position.Covering marketing research, after students have been exposed to consumer and business markets and segmentation.Integrating planning, implementation, and evaluation to provide a broad strategic context after students have a grasp of what marketing entails.

notes: 經管所和 IMBA 合開

description.zh: 本創新課程主要專為本校管理學院之國際學生而規劃，為了培養      本院畢業之國際管理碩士 IMBA 學生，運用其跨文化之多元優勢，與在本管理學院受多元學門之培育，未來能成為跨國產業界之優秀領導者，貢獻人群。透過動態激盪之個案研討，與實戰模擬，學生們將能啟動其創造力，學習開發與創新思維，進而建立其創造性思考，分析邏輯之架構，與實務界問題解決之道之整合管理能力。學生們亦將學習多元化之企業主題，包括有跨文化之商業交涉與溝通協商，創意之行銷策略，創業家精神，組織發展與團隊管理，領導學等實務模擬。經過整套課程之培育，透過哈佛管理個案與跨文化相關產業之分析與研討，期許 IMBA 國際學生們將建立實際應用到未來之職涯規劃與機會開展之學識，技術與能力，並本著具有仁愛，與誠信正直之寬廣胸懷，進而成為未來之優秀領導人。
description.en: This course is specifically designed for our International MBA studentswho have the heart of passion and willingness to become great leaders after graduation for their future career.  Through dynamic brain-power training, knowledge and intelligence building, case study and international simulations, we will activate the creative genes in each one of our IMBA students.  We will build their creative thinking, analytical reasoning, and problem solving abilities.  In the spirit of inspirational leadership, we will develop their creative marketing, managerial and organizational skills in the process of entrepreneurial case study and simulations.  Students will be able to draw upon their cross-cultural knowledge and learn how to apply what they have learnt in our business schools.  The main topics to be covered include cross-cultural business etiquettes, creative designing, innovative marketing, cross-cultural communication, analytical planning, cross-cultural negotiation, risk-taking, and

name.zh: 跨文化創造力與創業家策略

notes: IMBA 和資財所合開

description.zh: 物流管理包含依照顧客需求，由原料地至消費者間貨物與相關資訊有效率的流動與儲存之管理規劃。本課程在使學生瞭解生產的物品或提供的服務能適時適地，並以最少的成本送到顧客手中。本課程之內容如下：1. 物流管理和策略 2. 運輸和配送 3. 保管與包裝 4. 定單處理 5. 採購 6. 物料搬運 7. 物流成本 8. 物流服務 9. 資訊系統 10. 物流生產力衡量 11. 個案實務研討。
description.en: Logistics management includes management planning for the efficient flow and storage of goods and related information from raw materials to consumers in accordance with customer needs. The aim of the course is to help the students understand how to perform logistics activities so as to make products and services available to customers at the time place, and in the condition and from desired in the most profitable or cost-effective way. The content of the course description: 1. Logistics management & Strategy 2. Transportation 3. Inventory maintenance 4. Order processing 5. Purchasing 6.Warehousing & packaging 7. Materials handling 8. Logistics costs 9. Logistics customer service 10. Productivity measurement. 11. Case study.

notes: IMBA 和工管所合開

description.zh: 本課程專注在創業管理的基礎以及前瞻面向，以理論、實務、產業分析以及個案討論做為課程內容。創業課程在全球視野上涵蓋了科技性以及廣泛性的討論，其許多論點對於策略管理亦有重要的意涵。本課程將提供學生務實的方法引導未來創業所需的基礎以及營運新創事業的必要認知。期盼本課程中學生可以進行創業思考，了解創意與創業的執行方法，進而培育未來成功的創業家。
description.en: This course focuses on the fundamental and advanced aspects of management of start-up with theories, practices, industry analyses, and case studies. It is consciously designed with a technological and global outlook since this orientation in many ways highlights the significant emerging trends in strategic management. The course is intended to provide the students with a pragmatic approach that will guide the formulation and implementation of start up a high-tech business. Students are expected to think and behave with creativity and execution capability as successful entrepreneurs after the trainings from this course.

notes: IMBA 和資財所合開

description.zh: 一個數據模式是可以用來解釋結構性資料在商業環境下所代表的意義，而數據模組的建立，則是現實世界知訊管理系統中的自然而然產生的普遍結果。上述共同構成了我們當今被稱為數據分析系統，此系統是一種管理工具，提供用於評估及製定決策。本課程旨在介紹基礎數據模組的工具和使用方法以及相關主題，並會包含與強調在商業上的應用，其重點在不確定性模組建立與評估，理解決策的本質，有效利用數據和有限的信息來模擬複雜系統以及優化分配資源。
description.en: A data model describes how structured data is represented in a business environment. Data modeling is a natural consequence of the prevalence of management information systems in the real world. Together they form what in our days has become known as a Data Analytics system that provides management tools to evaluate performance and make decisions. The course aims to introduce the fundamentals of data models tools and methods and related topics. Business applications of the topics covered will be highlighted. The emphasis will be on modeling and evaluating uncertainty, understanding the nature of decision-making, using data and limited information efficiently simulating complex systems, and optimally allocating resources.

name.en: Analysis and Decision Making Using Data

Thechniques employed by the standards, e.g.,craier sense multiple access/collision avoidance (CSMA/CA),orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDA), will be discussed in details.

description.zh: 本課程旨在教授學生瞭解雲端環境及物聯網系統架構並進一步教授雲端環境及物聯網安全需求，課程內容除介紹雲端環境及物聯網系統的基本概念外，亦將由 OWASP 的雲端安全及物聯網安全重點進行說明，培養學生有能力分析雲端及物聯網環境中的各式潛在安全威脅，並具備設計與實作具安全防護能力的雲端及物聯網系統。課程內容包含：●雲服務技術簡介●雲服務安全●雲服務資安標準●物聯網技術簡介●工業物聯網潛在威脅●工控資安●物聯網資安檢測●物聯網資安標準●資安安全與隱私保護
description.en: This course aims to guide students understanding cloud environments and IoT systems and their corresponding security requirements. In addition to introducing basic concepts of cloud environment and IoT system, the course contents will focus on OWASP's cloud security and IoT security. All practical techniques will be explained. Students are able to analyze various potential security threats in the cloud and Internet of Things environments, and to learn security protection capabilities for cloud and IoT systems. Course contents including:●	Introduction to cloud technologies●	Introduction to cloud security●	Security standards for cloud services ●	Introduction to IoT technologies●	Potential threats of industrial IoT systems●	Industrial Cyber Security introduction●	IoT security detection●	IoT security standards●	Information security and privacy protection

notes: 資工所。創新資安和電資外生合開

description.en: This course is mainly to explore the methods of analyzing false information. Through this course, you will learn the techniques of analyzing false information, such as abnormal information, social engineering, propagation path and deep fake, including semantic analysis, account identification analysis and propagation path. Analysis of the impact of false information.

notes: 資工所。創新資安和電資外生合開

description.zh: 實現計算已從傳統地本地端機器獨立完成，進而委託上雲端等服務提供者協力完成。然而隨著資料或應用的授權，相關的計算安全性必須重新被探討。本課程將會從資料的隱密性出發，探討如何使用同態加密法輕鬆完成一個安全的授權計算，進而利用其他輕量化元件 (混淆電路、私密分享) 來取代同態加密並重新設計授權計算協定。接著會轉往定義資料的隱私性，並介紹 k 匿名等去識別化技術，最終帶入現今最嚴謹的差分隱私。透過上述之保有隱私與安全方法，將著名的人工智慧與機器學習演算法導入授權計算之中，重構不同情境的新型態安全計算框架。
description.en: The implementation of computation has been completed independently from the local machine, and then outsourced to the cloud (or some service providers) to complete it. However, with the delegation of data or applications, accordingly the security of such computation must be revisited. This course will start from the data confidentiality, discuss how to use homomorphic encryption to easily complete a secure outsourced computation, and then use other lightweight components (garbled circuit, secret sharing) to replace homomorphic encryption and redesign the secure protocols. Then it will move to define the privacy of data, introduce de-identification techniques such as k-anonymity, and finally bring the most rigorous notion of differential privacy. Through the above-mentioned methods of preserving privacy and security, artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms are introduced into the outsourced computation to reconstruct a new type of the framework for different scenarios.

notes: 資工所。創新資安和電資外生合開

description.zh: 資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
description.en: Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce the valuable knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The topics include data processing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. The course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with fundamental related knowledge and the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation-collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The course training is toward equipping students with the mindset and the ability to solve problems with the learned techniques on educational data. In addition, students need to practice the presentation for the findings of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually.

name.zh: 資料科學原理與教育數據應用
name.en: Data Science Principles with Applications on Educational Data

notes: 資工所和電資外生合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。1. 光電元件製造 2. 光纖製造 3. 光纖種類及特性 4. 光纖通訊系統 5. 光電控制電路 6. 電荷耦合元件 7. 液晶顯示元件
description.en: 1.Fabrication of optoelectronic devices 2.Fabrication of fibers 3.Fibers and their characteristics 4.Optical fiber communication systems 5.Optoelectronic control circuits6.Charge-coupled devices 7.Liquid crystal display

description.zh: 1. 簡介 2. 視覺與色彩 3. 陰極射線管顯示器 4. 電漿顯示器 5. 液晶顯示器 6. 電致發光顯示器 7. 場發射顯示器 8. 有機發光顯示器
description.en: 1.Introduction2.Sight and color3.Cathode-ray tube(CRT)4.Plasma panel display(PDP)5.Liquid crystal display(LCD)6.Electrolumisence display(ELP)7.Field emission display(FED)8.Organic light emitting device(OLED)

description.en: 1. Introduction to fiber optic sensor, 2. Fiber sensor devices, 3. Fiber sensor systems, 4. Fiber sensor multiplexing techniques, 5. Fiber-laser-based sensor systems, 6. Long-distance fiber sensor systems, 7. Large-scale multipoint fiber sensor systems, 8. Fiber sensor networks.

description.zh: 導論、積體電路生產介紹、半導體基礎、晶圓製造、加熱製程、微影蝕刻、電漿的基礎原理、離子佈植、化學氣相沉積與介電質薄膜、金屬化製程、化學機械研磨、製程整合、CMOS 製程
description.en: Introduction、Introduction to IC Fabrication、Semiconductor Basics、   Wafer Manufacturing、Thermal Processes、Photolithography and Etch、Plasma Basics、Ion Implantation、CVD and Dielectric Thin Film、  Metallization、CMP 、Process Integration、CMOS Processes

description.zh: 1. 人工智慧簡介及基本概念 2. 各種人工智慧技術介紹 3. 人工智慧工具和框架 4. 人工智慧在光電領域的應用
description.en: 1.	Introduction and basic concepts of artificial intelligence2.	Introduction to various artificial intelligence technologies3.	Artificial intelligence tools and frameworks4.	Application of artificial intelligence in the field of optoelectronics

notes: 光電四、光電所和電資外生合開

description.zh: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利範圍解讀開始，熟悉專利的權利範圍，然後介紹專利策略以及佈局的方向，提供專利佈局與專利策略理論及實務經驗。本課程的綱要如下：1. 專利權利項解讀 2. 專利侵權分析流程 3. 專利迴避設計要件 4. 專利策略分析 5. 專利佈局實務 6. 案例研究
description.en: Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around.  In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies.  However, in practice, they perform much less.  That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty.  This course will start from patent claim interpretation, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies.  The outline of this course is given as follows:Patent claim interpretation;Process of patent infringement analysis;Requirements of patent design around;Patent strategy analysis;Practice on patent strategies; andStudy on patent cases.

description.zh: 本課程主要以實務案例之解析為內容，並結合商標法理論剖析之教學方式，來深入介紹我國商標實務上之重要爭議，讓同學了解司法實務中，如何具體適用法律、判決或學說等。此外，本課程亦將分別介紹國外相關學說理論及著名司法案例，期望同學透過本課程之修習，來培養對國內外商標法案例思辨及評析之能力。
description.en: Primary contents of this course are focused on case analyses, and its teaching method is trademark legal theories analyses in order to further introduce significant disputes about Taiwan trademark practices. Thus, students could understand how to concretely apply laws, precedents, or theories to judicial practices. In addition, this course will also introduce relevant foreign theories and well-known judicial cases to develop students’ abilities of examining and analyzing domestic/foreign trademark cases when students take this course.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹專利檢索及專利地圖的觀念，課程包含以下兩部分：一、為什麼需要進行專利檢索以及如何有效率地找到相關前案，二、如何建構專利地圖及相關資訊的應用。
description.en: The concepts of patent search and patent map will be introduced in this course. The topics of the course includes: 1. Why it is important to do patent search. 2. How to find a related prior art efficiently, 3. How to construct a patent map and exploit related information.

description.zh: 本課程下學期亦以智慧財產局頒布之「專利審查基準」為藍本，先介紹專利申請之特殊分割程序與改請程序，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明先申請原則、發明單一性、優先權、說明書及圖式之補充與修正、更正、以及分割改請。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the special procedure for patent division application and patent conversion application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Then, in the "substantive examination" section, topics such as the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, the priority of a patent application, amendments of description, claims and drawings,  division of a patent and conversion of a patent will be sequentially discussed.

name.en: Examination Guidelines for Patent and Utility Model (II)

description.zh: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，準備實際電機技術 (元件、電路、方法) 之專利申請案，讓同學模擬實際申請專利的過程，首先是進行專利檢索與分析，討論專利佈局的策略；接著讓同學進行專利說明書 (含申請專利範圍) 撰寫實習，模擬實際上申請各國專利之程序，然後討論之後專利答辯、領證繳費及後續維護事宜。
description.en: In this course, we will focus on the practices of the patent application in   electrical engineering technology. Students will learn how to do patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and reply office action responses. In addition, the practical aspects of international patent application are presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies will be also discussed in class.

name.en: Practice of Electrical Engineering Technology Patent Application

description.zh: 本課程主要為台灣專利申請之文件，其相關的主題包括：專利之檢索、專利文件之閱讀，以及專利申請書、說明書、申請專利範圍與圖示等之撰寫。
description.en: This course focuses on the prosecution for Taiwan’s patents. The topics will include patent search, reading and drafting about patent specification, claims, figures and son on.

description.zh: 「心靈的理論與實踐」(The Theory and Practice of the Mind) 旨在對人的心理各個層面，從不同的角度進行探討。課程將以理論講授與實際操作交替進行：我們將借重當代學術研究成果，如腦神經科學、心理學、哲學、神經生物學、社會學等等，以增進我們對人自身重要議題的認識。這些議題至少包括：心靈 (Mind)、心流 (Mental Flow)、情緒 (Emotion)、選擇 (Choice)、決定 (Decision)、感官 (Sensations)、直覺 (Intuition)、自我分析 ( Self-Analysis)、單純性 (Simplicity)、潛意識 (Subconscious)、創新 (Novelty)、洞察力 (Insight) 與意志力 (Willpower) 等等。若時間允許，我們將在課上播放相關的科學影片與電影。
description.en: The course investigates several key aspects of human mind from different angles.  To achieve the goal, we shall discuss current topics and issues on the following subjects: Neuroscience, Psychology, Philosophy, Neurobiology, Sociology, etc.  The lecturing shall proceed from reading texts to practicing subjects and methods.  And the topics and issues will include at least: Mind, Mental flow, Emotion, Choice, Decision, Sensations, Intuition, Self-Analysis, Simplicity, Subconscious, Novelty, Insight, and Willpower, etc.  We may watch some relevant scientific films and movies in the class if time allows.

name.en: The Theory and Practice of the Mind

notes: 上限 10 人

description.zh: 本課程探究文化保存的各項議題，包含有形無形文化保存的真實性、文化價值的差異與認定、詮釋與再現；同時透過國內外文化保存的實踐案例的分析與討論，思考未來文化保存的多元發展可能性。
description.en: This course aims to understand the concept of cultural preservation, and the methods of doing cultural preservation by examining different case studies in the world. Different issues related to cultural preservation are also discussed in this course, include the value and authenticity of cultural heritage, the representation and interpretation of culture, and reuse and management of cultural spaces. A creative practice of cultural preservation will be conducted in this course.

notes: 配合 USR 計畫

description.zh: 本課程是動態影像的進階課程，不以歷史性發展為課程目的，旨在探究各類影像涉及的感官經驗以及所屬的文化意義，包含藝術電影、紀錄片、實驗電影與數位影像等，進而說明以動態經驗為基礎的混合現象，其涉及的美學、文化、技術與當代性。閱讀文本涵蓋電影、媒體與視覺文化評論。
description.en: This advanced moving images course aims to exam sensory experiences and cultural significances of various cinematic forms from art cinema, documentaries, and experimental images to the digital turn of VR films and beyond. However, the goal of the course is not to be a historical survey but instead an investigation of this hybrid moment and its relationship to aesthetics, culture, technology, and modernity. Readings cover topics in film theory, media theory, and visual cultural critical theory.

name.en: Theory and Praxis in Moving Images

notes: 上限 10 人

description.zh: 透過認識紙質、纖維實驗與材質研發的單元設計貫穿、活化課程，也由此串聯課程理念。達到培育美學素養、認識材質特性、應用紙藝與纖維文化。學生可透過選修這門課，養成美學素養、材質特色認識、紙藝與纖維文化應用。課程為理論與實務之結合，包含 : 1. 文化藝術與自然科學知識之傳授。2. 創意設計實作。後者 (2) 可做為檢視學生對前者 (1) 的學習與吸收狀況。作業訓練達到二項目標 : 1. 加強產學合作，強化實務教學。2. 培育紙質與纖維創意設計人才。
description.en: With the help of curricular components of paper qualities, fiber experiments as well as R&D on raw materials, the course essentials can thus be unified and the theme vitalized. WE aim to provide the course with aesthetical principles, knowledge of the raw materials, applied paper craftsmanship and fiber civilization—which will be comprehensively instilled into the course so that the students who take the course will be equipped with a good command on them. The course is made up of both aesthetical theory and practice, including a) knowledge on culture, arts and natural science and b) innovative & creative practice, with the later utilized as criteria to evaluate to what extent the students are successfully trained. The assigned homework is set so as to: 1. Enforce cooperation between industry and academics and strengthen course materials into practice; 2. Train and discipline more design talents in paper qualities and innovation in fiber.

name.en: Paper’s Fiber Culture and Its Application

notes: 上限 13 人

description.zh: 使學生瞭解科學研究的特性、研究的類型、測量的程序與工具、資料的收集、資料的分析、撰寫研究計畫的方法，在從事管理問題之研究與探討時，知道如何正確選用適當方法，並取得所需資訊。
description.en: This course will introduce the selection of a research topic, construction of a bibliography, literature survey and data collection, and preparation of a research proposal.

notes: 科研 825

description.zh: 本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。目的二，進一步教授 ESG 及聯合國 SDGs 指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。最後，透過對於 ESG 與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

description.zh: 本課程將由個人資料保護原則開始對個人資料保護作全面性的介紹，並說明《個人資料保護法》與《個人資料保護法施行細則》如何與個資保護原則互相呼應，期使學生瞭解目前個人資料保護的管理議題與實務考量，並且說明可參考的標準與指引，以強化學生對於個人資料保護的基礎概念。藉由《個人資料保護法》及《個人資料保護法施行細則》的介紹帶入 ISO/IEC 29100 的個資保護框架、隱私衝擊評鑑 (PIA)，接下介紹 ISO/IEC 27701 個資保護實作指引等相關國際標準，本課程以實際的案例以及國際標準讓學生這對於個人資料保護有更進一步的概念與瞭解。
description.en: This course will begin with a comprehensive introduction to personal data protection principles and explain in detail the "Personal Data Protection Act" and the "Enforcement Rules of the Personal Data Protection Act". Student will learn managerial and practical considerations of personal data protection. Relevant standards and guidelines, such as ISO/IEC 29100, ISO/IEC 27701, will be discussed to strengthen students' understanding of fundamental concepts of personal information management systems (PIMS). In addition, the process of a privacy impact assessment (PIA) and its related standard ISO/IEC 29134 will also be introduced in this course. All in all, this course aims to give students a solid understanding of personal data protection through cases studies and international standards.

notes: 資財所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 本課程介紹資金管理的理論與實務應用。如何判斷一個交易系統好壞，使其不斷產生利潤？我們將從理論出發，套用在實務交易模擬上，包含單一策略、多商品、多市場、多策略的運用。本課程將以 R 語言搭配模擬。
description.en: This course introduces the theory and practice of money management. How to determine a trading system is good or bad, how to continues to generate profits in a trading system? We will start from the theory, applied to the simulation of real trading market, including single strategy, multi-commodities, multi-markets, multi-strategies. This course will be run with R language.

description.zh: 本課程將延續財務工程導論的內容，將持續在衍生性商品評價、避險以及風險控管等問題上繼續深入探討；本學期將把焦點放在股票衍生性商品與利率衍生性商品的評價與避險上，並利用 C (或 C++) 和 Matlab 兩種工具來執行 (1) 樹狀結構 (2) 蒙地卡羅法 以評價選擇權的價值。
description.en: This course will still focus on the methods for derivatives pricing and hedging, such as the evaluation of stock and interest rate options. For implementation purposes associated with the concepts introduced, such as the tree structure and Monte Carlo simulation, two programming languages for computation will be provided: C (or C++ ) and Matlab.

description.zh: 區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦… 等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管… 等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
description.en: Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

notes: 哈佛 / 資財四甲、資財所合開

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹人工智慧（AI）領域包含各種機器學習的開發與實作，特別關注如何使用 Python 進行模型的開發與部屬。課程將涵蓋深度學習的基本概念、常見的 AI 框架（如 TensorFlow、Keras），並深入探討如何利用 Python 編程語言來設計、訓練與優化 AI 模型。此外，課程也將重點討論人工智慧在開發與部屬過程中需要考量的安全性問題，從資料安全與可稽核性，AI 透明度，模型加密與攻擊防範等，提供學生一套全面的安全檢核框架。學生將學習如何確保 AI 系統在實際應用中具備高度的安全性與可靠性，並瞭解如何在 AI 部屬的不同階段識別與解決潛在的安全風險。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the development and implementation of various machine learning techniques in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI), with a particular focus on how to use Python for model development and deployment. The course will cover the fundamental concepts of deep learning, popular AI frameworks (such as TensorFlow and Keras), and will delve into how to use the Python programming language to design, train, and optimize AI models. Additionally, the course will emphasize the security considerations necessary during the development and deployment of AI systems, including data security and auditability, AI transparency, model encryption, and attack prevention. Students will be provided with a comprehensive security framework to evaluate these concerns. They will also learn how to ensure the high security and reliability of AI systems in practical applications, and how to identify and mitigate potential security risks at various stages of AI deployment.

notes: 資財四甲、資財所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 本課程將介紹環境、社會和治理 (ESG) 投資的概念。ESG 投資，也稱為永續投資，是一種將 ESG 因素與基本面分析結合起來進行投資決策的投資策略。首先，我將介紹一些投資的基本概念，例如績效衡量和因子模型分析。接下來，我將介紹 ESG 因子，並從學術研究和實務觀點討論 ESG 投資。此外，我將為您提供有關 ESG 投資的另類觀點。最後，本課程將關注全球暖化和氣候變遷議題，並提供修課同學環境教育的重要概念。
description.en: This course introduces the concepts of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investing. ESG investing, also referred to as sustainable investing, represents an investment strategy that incorporates ESG factors alongside fundamental analysis in investment decision-making. Initially, I will introduce some essential concepts of investment, such as performance measurement and factor model analysis. Next, I will review ESG factors and discuss ESG investing from both academic and practical perspectives. Furthermore, I will provide you with alternative viewpoints on ESG investing. Finally, I will focus on the issues of global warming and climate change, which are critical components of environmental education.

notes: 1 週【停開】

description.zh: 本課程結合設計思考與深度學習技術，專為金融領域應用而設計。學生將學習設計思考的五個核心步驟：同理心、問題定義、創意發想、原型設計和測試，並運用這些步驟解決金融實際問題。課程內容涵蓋數據收集與清洗、特徵工程、深度學習模型構建與訓練，及模型部署與應用。學生將使用 Pandas、NumPy、Keras、TensorFlow 等工具，進行數據處理和模型開發，並通過 PBL 項目進行實務操作，體驗跨域合作的過程。課程特別強調實務應用，涵蓋信用風險評估、股票價格預測、信用卡欺詐檢測等金融案例。學生將參與多次業界專家分享和企業參訪，了解最新的行業動態和實務經驗。本課程致力於培養具備前瞻性思維、創新能力和實務操作能力的金融科技專業人才。
description.en: This course combines design thinking and deep learning techniques tailored for financial applications. Students will explore the five key steps of design thinking: empathy, problem definition, ideation, prototyping, and testing. These steps will be applied to solve practical financial challenges.The course content includes data collection and cleaning, feature engineering, deep learning model building, training, and deployment. Students will work with tools like Pandas, NumPy, Keras, and TensorFlow for data analysis and model development. The learning process is enriched through PBL (Project-Based Learning) projects, offering hands-on experience in interdisciplinary teamwork.By integrating technical skills and innovative thinking, this course aims to develop forward-thinking financial technology professionals equipped with practical expertise.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於從科學哲學層次、研究方法層次、與實際操作層次探討設計研究的本質，內容包括界定設計研究問題、選用適當的量化或質性研究方法與特定工具、研究結果詮釋、案例解析、以及論文寫作等，俾使同學具備研究之基礎觀念以及進行創作或論文寫作之能力。研究方法二強調質性研究，例如：以深度訪談以及參與式觀察法探究互動行為脈絡，課程內容包含質性研究導論、質性研究過程與步驟、質性研究設計、質性研究方法、譯碼的程序、質性資料蒐集與分析、質性研究報告撰寫、質性研究在創新設計研究上的應用。教學以課堂講授與論文研討與發表為主要方式，並以隨堂測驗、報告與分組討論與發表為評量依據。
description.en: The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and practical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis.This course provides graduate students with the ability of fundamental concept and design creation or research thesis. These research methods two focus on qualitative research with the exploration of in-depth interview and participant observation. The details of content includes introduction, research process and approaches, research design, research methods, coding scheme, data collection and analysis, writing up and implication of innovation and design. The teaching methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discuss

notes: 一般教室，限本班生 25 人修 (非本班生勿選)

description.zh: 本課程為一延續性的專題研究，其目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: This special topic is a continuous course within two semesters. This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, interactive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and practice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct a multi-disciplines learning environment which performs a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate a interactive media design project. It may execute interactive media design by wo

name.en: Special Topics on Interactive Media Design (II)

notes: 一般教室，限本班生 25 人修 (非本班生勿選)

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入虛擬實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及虛擬實境遊戲設計、虛擬實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。
description.en: The main objective of the program is taking from the application and design perspective, cutting into the possibilities of the virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

notes: 大三 / 外生三 / 日碩 / 外碩合開，一般教室，各 13 人，自備筆電

description.zh: 本課程將透過介紹及研讀創新服務的標竿案例，以了解創新服務的本質與實質效益。學生將透過共同研討與分組實作的的方式，針對不同場域及技術的創新服務，透過資源整合的方式，提出具體的創新服務專案，並提出其評估的方法。
description.en: This course will provide the student basics knowledge and practical benefits of the innovative services through benchmark case introduction and study. Students will collaborate to each other to propose practical innovation service project proposal in the aspect of resources management, technology applications, service mechanism and associated assessment methods  in various domains.

notes: 互動日碩、外碩合開，PBL 教室，限 40 人

description.zh: 讀書報告、專題討論、機械與自動化科技相關技術及產品介紹與討論、Seminar 心得等，可重覆修習。
description.en: Case study, workshop, group discussion, seminars, mechanical engineering and automation in modern Industries.

notes: 機電博和機械自動化外生班合開

description.zh: 碩士學位論文研究與寫作。
description.en: A student must write a thesis to fulfill the partial requirements for the Master degree.

description.zh: 本課程專注於太空系統設計、驗證和確認的基本概念與技術。本課程涵蓋了任務要求、系統架構、系統貿易研究、設計優化以及驗證和確認方法等主題。學生將學習如何設計符合特定任務要求的太空系統，同時確保系統具有可靠、安全和高效的特性。本課程還將向學生介紹各種驗證和確認性能的技術，包括模擬、測試和分析。
description.en: Mission and System Design, Verification and Validation is a course that focuses on the fundamental concepts and techniques used in the design, verification, and validation of aerospace systems. This course covers topics such as mission requirements, system architectures, system trade studies, design optimization, and verification and validation methods. Students will learn how to design aerospace systems that meet specific mission requirements while also ensuring the system is reliable, safe, and efficient. The course will also introduce students to various techniques for verifying and validating the performance of aerospace systems, including simulation, testing, and analysis. By the end of this course, students will have a deep understanding of the process of designing, verifying, and validating aerospace systems.

name.zh: 任務和系統設計驗證確認
name.en: Mission and System Design, Verification and Validation

notes: 億光 405 教室，與自動化所跨所合開

description.zh: 複雜系統專案管理是一種專門用於複雜項目的管理技巧。它使用分項管理方法，來預測和了解不斷變化的應用環境，確保複雜的工程項目的品質和成本，以及確保計劃準時完成。它由深入的規劃、品質管理、問題解決、進度及準確的檢測和調整所組成，並從團隊中運用整合協調和溝通管理，確保具備競爭優勢的項目順利達成。課程中包含，複雜系統專案概念，管理能力、架構、流程、方法等。
description.en: Project management of complex systems is a management technique specifically designed for complex projects. It uses an itemized management approach to predict and understand the different application environments, ensure the quality and cost of complex projects, and ensure that programs are completed on time. This course includes complex systems project concepts, management capabilities, structures, processes, and methodologies.

description.zh: 本課程屬於影像處理的進階課程，以遙測影像為主軸，聚焦於多光譜和高光譜影像分析與處理，並將涵蓋一般日常使用的彩色影像（多光譜影像的一種），分析各自不同的差異以及所需的影像處理技術。課程內容將涵蓋多光譜和高光譜影像的基礎、各種影像於分析時所面臨的挑戰以及所需的影像處理技術，包括線性分解、資料降維與升維、光譜與空間上的特徵萃取、機器與深度學習演算法。 選修本課程的學生需要具備基礎的信號處理、機率、線性代數和影像處理方面的背景。
description.en: This is an advanced course on image processing. The main focus of this course is the analysis and processing of multispectral and hyperspectral images. It will cover the general color images as a type of multispectral image based on remote sensing for analysis of their differences and corresponding image processing techniques. The scope of this course includes fundamentals of multispectral and hyperspectral imagery, challenges in image analysis, and corresponding image processing techniques, such as linear unmixing, dimensionality reduction, spectral and spatial feature extraction, and machine/deep learning algorithms. Students are expected to have a basic background in signal processing, probability, linear algebra, and image processing prior to taking this course.

notes: 太空所和創新 AI 合開，億光 405 教室

description.zh: 太空工程實務專題課程旨在讓學生瞭解和掌握太空工程領域的實踐技能和實務知識，以及培養學生的團隊協作、問題解決和創新思維能力。學生將進行一個實際的太空工程設計項目，通過實踐瞭解太空工程的設計、測試、實施和管理流程，並透過報告、演示和評審等形式展示項目成果。通過此課程的學習，學生可以瞭解太空工程領域的最新發展，掌握相關的技能和知識，並提升團隊合作和項目管理能力。本課程可同時藉由產學合作設計進行實際演練。
description.en: The aim of the Space Engineering Practical Project course is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

notes: 億光 405 教室

description.zh: 本課程探討衛星通訊系統收發機設計，介紹衛星端與地球站通訊收發資料流。課程涵蓋的主題包括：通訊協定、通道編碼演算法、調變技術、多天線設計、軟體無線電技術、通訊數據機實現。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解衛星通訊收發機設計的技巧，並學習以軟體無線電實現通訊數據機。
description.en: This course discusses the design of transceivers for satellite communication systems and introduces the flow of data sent and received in communications between satellites and earth stations. Topics covered in the course include communication protocols, channel coding algorithms, modulation technology, multi-antenna design, software-defined radio technology, and the implementation of communication modem. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the techniques of satellite communication transceiver design and learn to implement communication modems using software-defined radios.

notes: 億光 405 教室，與電資學院低軌衛星通訊與接取網路

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在探討太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，與太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的專題演講與小組討論，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

notes: 億光 405 教室

description.zh: 本課程目的為深入研究非地面通訊網路（NTN）的相關技術和應用。課程將首先介紹 NTN 的基本概念，包括其定義、特點以及在通訊領域中的角色。接著，將深入研究 NTN 網路的架構和應用，使學生了解 NTN 在不同場景中的實際應用情境。課程亦將探討 3GPP 對 NTN 網路的規劃和進展，使學生瞭解 NTN 在國際通訊標準中的地位與發展趨勢。此外，課程還將介紹不同類型的 NTN，包括各種型態的應用範疇和特點。而隨著 5G 的發展，課程也將討論 NTN 在 B5G/6G 系統中的應用和相關標準化。學生將了解 NTN 如何融入未來通訊網路的發展趨勢，以應對更高效、更智能的通訊需求。最後，課程將深入討論 NTN 的重要議題，包括安全性、效能優化和未來發展方向等方面。透過課程，學生將獲得對 NTN 技術全面且深入的理解，並具備應用和解決相關議題的能力。
description.en: This course explores the technologies and applications of Non-Terrestrial Communication Networks (NTN). Starting with the basics, it introduces NTN's definition, characteristics, and role in communication. This course then investigates NTN network architecture and applications, offering practical insights. The course also covers 3GPP's planning for NTN networks, understanding NTN's global position and development trends. Different NTN types and their characteristics are introduced, along with discussions on NTN's applications in B5G/6G systems within the context of 5G development. The course concludes with an in-depth discussion on key NTN issues, including security, performance optimization, and future directions. Students will gain a comprehensive understanding of NTN technology and the capability to address relevant issues.

notes: 億光 405 教室，與電子所跨所合開，與電資學院

description.zh: 本課程介紹系統分析的基本概念與方法，以及如何從一個系統的角度來看待和設計複雜的資訊系統，從而提高系統的效率和效益。內容包含：系統分析、系統設計、系統建置、系統運轉、系統評鑑等之實施方式及步驟。學生需要學習使用一些專業工具，如統一塑模語言、資料流圖、結構化程式設計。
description.en: This course introduces the basic concepts and methods of system analysis, as well as how to approach and design complex information systems from a systemic perspective, in order to improve system efficiency and effectiveness. The content includes implementation methods and steps such as system analysis, system design, system construction, system operation, and system evaluation. Students are required to learn to use some professional tools such as Unified Modeling Language (UML), data flow diagrams, and structured programming.

description.zh: 「鐵道車輛系統與維修基地」課程，乃為培養具有鐵路車輛分析設計及檢修技術操作能力之人員，掌握鐵道裝備設計製造、檢修的基礎知識與應用能力，具有鐵道車輛製造、檢修、運用、管理等綜合職業能力和創新精神的高素質技能型專門人才。本課程將從鐵道車輛基本結構開始介紹，並探討鐵道車輛與鐵道基礎之互制關係。而後導入各式特殊鐵道車輛設計之原理與用途，如：高速客車、傾斜式列車、自導向系統…. 等，並研討各種車型之行駛穩定性與脫軌風險計算方式。最後介紹鐵道車輛維修之概念與實務，並介紹維修基地之設計與配置，再導入先進預兆健康預防檢修法與 AR 技術於檢修之應用與發展。
description.en: This course of "Railway Vehicle System and Maintenance Depot" will cover the basic design criteria of the railway vehicle, its sub-systems and integration. We will discuss factors that affect the design, sizing, manufacturing and maintenance of the sub-systems of the railway vehicle, including their integration with other sub-systems to work as one complete train. Various factors affecting reliability, accessibility and maintainability will be addressed. Then several types of vehicle (high-speed-vehicle, tilting train, self-guide bogie will be introduced to determine the dynamic stability and derailment risk. Finally, the design of maintenance depot will be studied and the latest technologies (PHM, AR) on railway vehicle maintenance will be introduced.

description.en: This course introduces the concepts in big data mining and advanced applications in machine learning. Topics include big data concepts, distributed computing infrastructure, and machine learning methods commonly used in processing big data, such as neural networks, support vector machines. In addition to concept introduction, parallel programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the processing steps and practical tools in big data anlaytics.

description.zh: 當代都市議題經常為跨領域、開放性的複雜問題，在資料蒐集與分析上，需要整合地理空間、時間的維度；在分析與對策上，須平衡公部門、私部門、民眾等多重利害關係者的，是一門相當複雜但重要的學問。本課程從真實的都市議題出發，教導學生掌握地理空間資訊、資料分析、資料建模、資訊視覺化、策略論述等綜合能力，培養學生對於都市複雜議題的觀察與剖析，進而對真實環境提出洞見與創意。
description.en: Contemporary urban issues are complex, requiring the integration of geographical, and temporal dimensions in data collection and analysis. Balancing the interests of stakeholders like the public, and private sectors is crucial. This course focuses on real urban issues, teaching skills in geographical information, data analysis, modeling, visualization, and strategic discourse. It aims to cultivate students' ability to observe, analyze urban issues, and propose insights for real environments. It's an advanced course, requiring basic programming and GIS concepts. Through group projects, students learn API usage, geographic computation, model building, and data visualization. The course includes one midterm report and one final project report.

This course focuses on its applications from software/program verification to machine-checkable proofs. Through various tools like SAT/SMT solvers and proof-assistant Coq, this course will cover the following topics: proportional logic, first-order logic, satisfiability module theory, model checking and program verification.

description.en: The concept of photoelectrochemistry is to utilize the solar energy and other light sources to drive a complete electrochemical oxidation-reduction reaction where the photocatalytic electron reaction has been converted into electrical energy. Photovoltaic cells which also known as solar cells composed of organic and inorganic materials and electrolytes are the great example for the photoelectrochemical reactions. Here the proposed course is constructed to introduce and implement the basic photoelectrochemical principles, measurements, photoelectrocatalysis, photoelectrical charge transfer and the storage of chemical energy. Further the remaining section of this course will be focused on the detailed studies about the development of different inorganic, organic materials for the fabrication of dye-sensitized solar cells.

description.zh: 由於雲端運算的快速發展，大量資料收集與儲存技術已成瓶頸，大數據技術與管理提供一套具延展性與容錯能力的分散儲存與計算架構，能有效處理大量複雜數據資料的儲存與運算。本課程除介紹現有的大數據生態與趨勢，並針對目前軟硬體架構的處理瓶頸，提供系統組態與部署、服務層級協定、監控與管理等系統性規劃的解決方案，並導入跨領域的工程管理科學知識。課程簡扼論述大數據技術與管理的重要，並在 Hadoop 生態系統中，以 Cloudera Hadoop 為應用範例，實作說明其重要性。課程內容包括：大數據的概念、應用生態與趨勢、Hadoop 硬體規格與基礎架構規劃、叢集組態與部署、叢集服務層級協定、叢集監控與管理、相關生態技術、及概略介紹 Hadoop 認證與準備。
description.en: The course will introduce Apache Hadoop core technologies and administration with its major including: Big Data (BD) in demand and its application trend, Core technologies of Hadoop for BD management, Hadoop Administration and management tool, Hadoop cluster deployment,YARN applications plus MapReduce, Hadoop cluster hardware and software, Introduction of Hadoop ecosystem projects, HDFS configuration for high availability (HA), Hadoop security, Cluster resource scheduling and configuration, and Hadoop certification program, etc.

notes: 限 12 人，綜科 318

description.zh: 瞭解 CMOS 超大型積體電路之電路元件特性及其組合電路之分析與設計方法，其內容包含：金氧半電晶體電路特性分析、電路性能評估、電路模擬、組合電路設計、序向電路設計、設計方法分析、測試與驗證、CMOS 案例討論與 Verilog HDL 設計等課程內容。
description.en: This course covers the electric specification, circuit analyses, and design methods of the CMOS VLSI. The contents of this course include: Circuit characterization, performance estimation, Circuit simulation, Combinational circuit, Sequential circuit, Design methodology, Testing and verification, CMOS case study, and Verilog HDL design.

description.zh: 本課程探討無線通訊系統基頻演算法設計，主要包含多輸入多輸出傳輸系統中接收端與傳送端之聯合最佳化問題。課程綱要：1. 基本矩陣運算 2. 多輸入多輸出接收機設計 3. 多輸入多輸出天線選擇 4. 多輸入多輸出前置編碼器設計
description.en: This course aims at the baseband algorithm design for wireless communication systems. Much attention will be focused on the joint multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) transceiver optimization.Course outline:1.Basic matrix operations.2.MIMO receiver design.3.MIMO antenna selection.4.MIMO precoder design.

description.zh: 本課程程主要為介紹深度學習和生成式人工智慧概念和基本原理。通過掌握這些原理，學生能了解可能極限，更能思考深度學習和和生成式人工智慧的應用。
description.en: This course mainly introduces the concepts and basic principles of deep learning and generative artificial intelligence. By mastering these principles, students can understand the limits of what is possible and be better able to think about the applications of deep learning and generative artificial intelligence.

name.zh: 深度學習和生成式人工智慧導論
name.en: Introduction to Deep Learn and Generative Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 本課程包含：1. 散射參數與網路分析儀 2. 頻譜儀介紹 3. 自動化量測 4. 平面化傳輸線 5. 射頻集總元件與阻抗匹配 6. 積體電路封裝 7. 射頻耦合器 8. 射頻濾波器學生能從這門課學習到射頻被動元件的分析、設計與應用。
description.en: This course covers: 1.S-parameter and Network Analyzer2.Introduction to Spectrum Analyzer3.Automatic Measurement4.Planar Transmission Lines5.RF Lump Elements and Impedance Matching6.IC Package7.RF Coupler8.RF FilterThe students can learn the analysis, design, and applications of RF passive circuits from this course.

description.zh: 1. 固體結晶結構 2. 能隙與載子 3. 載子傳輸 4. 過量載子 5. P-N 接面 6. 金半接面及半導體異質接面 7. 金屬氧化物半導體場效電晶體 8. 雙極電晶體

description.en: It is a fundamental course concerning the theories of robotic manipulators. Topics contain frame transformations, manipulator kinematics, inverse kinematics, dynamics, trajectory planning, manipulator design, control of manipulators, robot programming languages.

notes: 綜科 327

description.zh: 本課程將以 BIM 之觀點，介紹國內外建築資訊模型及建築資訊模型案例，包含建築資訊模型及探討 BIM 之設計與實作，希望學生能夠經由防救災或工程管理之需求分析開始，瞭解 BIM 建築資訊系統之架構與應用，進而設計一個 BIM 在防救災與管理之實務應用，其內容包括：BIM 自動化防救災應用，BIM 實務應用，國內外 BIM 案例探討，BIM 應用之分析與設計，BIM 系統設計與開發，BIM 系統在防救災與工程管理之應用等內容。
description.en: Building Information Modeling (BIM) is increasingly important for applications disaster prevention and management recently. The course introduces the BIM use, modeling, design, development, and related applications for disaster prevention and engineering management. The course is a combination of lectures, readings, hands-on exercises, homework assignments, a midterm report and a final project. The course allows students to develop a BIM-related applications suitable to their own researches to meet disaster prevention or engineering management requirement.

name.zh: 建築資訊模型與防救災及工程管理
name.en: Applications of Building Information Modeling for Disaster Prevention and Engineering Management

description.zh: 為使土木營建背景的學生具備跨域學習與創用能力，本課程扣合當前重要時趨 (如 SDGs, ESG, LCA, ESDG/USR 等) 於土木與防災之低碳管理。擇採綠色與數位雙軸科技 (如數位碳盤查與減碳之智化物聯網 AIoT) 作為課程雙核心編排，介紹內容如碳 - 水 - 環境足跡之盤查與減碳策略、綠 - 智 - 健康之數位雲平台、無線感測與低工耗遠域網路等專案開發的理與例，以符綠智營建之踐履，以臻永續經管之倡議。為求哲科合一，課程亦將思與學之認識與方法作簡扼介紹 (系統思考與問題導向學習)。
description.en: To achieve interdisciplinary learning and innovative creativity for civil engineering students, this course presents the Carbon-Water-Environmental inventory associated with Artificial Intelligent/Internet of Things (AIoT) to meet sustainable development of civil engineering and disaster adaptation/mitigation. The contents in this class include sustainable development goals such as SDGs, ESG, LCA, ESDG/USR briefly, green-intelligent-healthy construction/maintenance and resilient projects, WSN (Wireless Network), LPWAN (Low Power Wide-Area Network), e-Cloud Management.Meanwhile, Systems Thinking (ST) and Problem-based Learning (PBL) , which are crucial for philosophy of science, would be introduced for this holistic approach.

name.zh: 土木與防災之低碳管理
name.en: Low Carbon Management of Civil Engineering and Disaster Prevention

description.en: Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction-Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.

description.zh: 本課程在透過研討，讓學生瞭解科技管理觀念和趨勢。主要包括以下課題：（1）創新與研發管理（2）科技政策（3）技術預測（4）技術策略管理（5）技術開發與移轉（6）技術規劃與評估。
description.en: The course teaches the student Technology Management concepts and trend . The topics will be covered: (1) innovation and R&D management; (2) technology policy; (3) technology forecasting ; (4) technology strategy management ; (5) technology development and transfer; (6) technology planning and measurement.

notes: 綜科 421

description.zh: 本課程針對目前通用之真空系統原理、設計及實務組裝等議題進行說明與分析。將先針對真空系統進行分類說明，並陳述真空系統實務組裝時所要考慮的事項，以及說明真空系統的抽氣概念與設計。真空腔體的設計原理將會詳細說明，並介紹中低真空、高真空及超高真空的系統設計。
description.en: This class explains and analyzes issues concerning the principle, design, and assembly of vacuum systems that are commonly used today. We will begin with the classification of the vacuum system, then goes into the cautions regarding the assembly of the vacuum systems, as well as the concept and design of the air extraction of the vacuum system. We will also discuss the design principles for the vacuum cavity, and the system design for medium-low, high, and super-high vacuum systems.

description.zh: 實驗是進行科學與工程研究不可或缺的工具，實驗方法的設計與實驗數據的分析更是決定實驗結果品質優劣的關鍵，本課程將介紹實驗過程所必須具備的各項知識，以數據的量測與分析為開始，並介紹量測各類物理量的感測元件，如壓力、溫度、流量及聲波等，以建立學生具備實驗量測的基礎。課程主要內容包含有基本量測、量測標準、量測單位、訊號讀取、資料簡報、數據的準確性與變異性、類比訊號量測、數位訊號量測、系統響應、感測器。
description.en: Introduction of Experiment and Measurement MethodExperiment is the essential tool for the research of science and engineering. The design of experiment and the analysis of data are the keys of the high quality of experiment. The course will introduce the materials of experiment and measurement. The procedures of measurement and the analysis method of data will be detailed investigated. And then the sensors to measure the interested physical parameters of pressure, temperature, flow rate and acoustic will be introduced. The technology of measurement and analysis of experiment will be built up in the course. The contents of the course are basic measurement, standards of measurement, dimension of measurement, access data, data presentation, accuracy and uncertainty of data, analog signal measurement, digital signal measurement, system response, and sensors.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹化學儲能裝置和儲冷系統之基礎與實務。課程內容包括：(一) 儲能裝置理論與技術：電池儲能系統與模組、轉換器，各式燃料電池，如燐酸電池，質子交換電池等。(二) 儲冷系統理論與技術：儲冰水式系統，各式儲冰系統如全凍結式、冰盤管式、冰泥式、動態製冰式、優態鹽及冰球式等。
description.en: This course including two parts:electrochemical energy storage/conversion theory and technology, and thermal storage system fundamental and technology:Electric cell engergy conversion system and module, transformer and fuel cells such as phosphatic cell and proton-exchanging chilled water systemand ice storage systems such as total freeze-up, ice-on-coil,ice slurry, dynamic ice builder, eutectic salt and ice ball systechnology will also be covered.  The advanced PCM for thermal storage will be investigated as a hint to the students.
