description.en: The Machine Learning course is to introduce and study the machine learning concepts, algorithms, application methodologies and its applications on engineering and management. The course encompasses the following topics.1. Machine learning concepts and applications.2. Machine learning algorithms. 3. Inductive learning algorithms. 4. Decision tree algorithms. 5. Case-based learning algorithms. 6. Construction of expert systems. 7. Applications of machine learning. 8. Paper readings on machine learning. 9. Projects on machine learning.

description.zh: 隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅 B2C 市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。在台灣，擁有十個以上員工的公司有 86% 有自屬的企業網站，而擁有自屬網站的頁有近七成聘僱網頁設計師進駐公司任職，面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來 DIY 速成個人事業及就業的能力
description.en: Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

notes: 配合 USR 計畫

description.zh: 本課程引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。
description.en: This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. Essential topics include communication, techniques of negotiation and presentation, applied reading and writing, strategies for developing listening skills and language learning across cultures.

notes: 英語授課

description.zh: 超低溫冷凍通常指進行在 - 100℃以下特定低溫範圍之冷凍技術應用，譬如高能能物理同步輻射冷卻，生物醫學胚胎冷凍保存，大型超低溫冷能氣化發電廠與中、長程飛彈推進系統冷卻技術等，現代微系統科技多方面高層次應用上之必要技術。故如何進行實質而有效整合超低溫系統技術，是決定未來國力競爭之主要關鍵項目。本課程主要內容將涵蓋：1. 多段多元化自動冷卻系統技術。2. . 超低溫循環冷媒特性。3. 生物基因晶化冷凍技術應用。4. 系統裝置之材料選擇。5. 電子微觀系統應用。6. 超低溫冷卻劑之檢測與分析。
description.en: At the completion will have learned of this course:1. Multiple stage and cascade refrigeration systems technology.2. Refrigerant characteristics for low-temperature cycle.3. Biomedical applications of cryogenic refrigeration.4. Choice of low-temperature materials for refrigeration systems.5. Research applications of electron microscopy.6. Refrigerant properties of super low-temperature coolants.

notes: 2/4 停開【停開】

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解世界地域文化中，因人、因時、因地制宜的建築生產過程，及其涉入空間行為因時間積累而呈現的特殊環境型態、類型與結構；即在探討地方自然地理環境，如何經由人類行為的涉入，呈現出富鄉土涵構的人文景觀。
description.en: This course is to understand the relations between human, behavior, material and the environment of architecture in the world. And try to introduce the vernacular characters of the World architecture by the discussion of some special architectural themes.

description.zh: 本課程主要在教導學生深入探討最新的室內環境議題與人體健康間的關係，使學生具備創造健康室內環境的相關知識及操作能力，主要授課要點如下：1. 以單一類型的建築室內環境為探討主題；2. 探討環境影響人體健康之最新研究議題；3. 進行跨領域合作提出共同改善之策略及方法；4. 學習各項環境量測儀器之原理、操作與判讀能力；5. 具備診斷與改善特殊室內環境議題之專業知識及操作能力。
description.en: In this course students are going to be taught how to discuss the relationship between indoor environment quality and human healthy in order to promote students' recognition and abilities to create healthy indoor environment.Contents :1. The indoor environment of single type of building.2. The relationship between the artificial environment and human health.3. Providing some strategies and methods to improve indoor environment quality through cooperating with other science field.4. Learning how to use instruments to evaluate indoor environment quality.5. Learning how to diagnose and improve the special topics of indoor environment quality.

name.en: Special Topics on Indoor Environment Quality

notes: 停開，2 週【停開】

description.zh: 本課程是在講述建築生命週期碳足跡的評估法。藉由標準化、透明化的建築資訊，一步步剖析建築生命週期各階段對環境的影響。本課程得評估整棟建築生命週期的碳足跡、甚進一步提出減碳熱點，了解建築物的節碳潛力所在。
description.en: This course evaluates the carbon footprint of a building's life cycle. Through standardized and transparent building information, the impact of various stages of the building life cycle on the environment is analyzed step by step. This course not only evaluates the carbon footprint of the entire building life cycle but also further identifies carbon hotspots and provides carbon reduction strategies, hence understanding carbon savings potential of buildings.

name.en: THE EVALUATION FOR BUILDING'S CARBON FOOTPRINT

description.zh: 專題討論照明與視覺心理等課題，期能對於照明相關知識能有深刻了解，並能藉課堂的研討與文獻閱讀等方法提出見解。課程內容包括永續發展之綠色照明、照明與色彩、眩光之評價、光源之新發展、燈具之美、高齡者之照明環境、防災照明、視覺與輝度分布、照明耗能評估指標與基準、晝光利用、照明之控制、道路照明與安全、戶外照明與都市環境、光污染等。
description.en: The topic is discussed with lighting and visual psychology that expect to understand some knowledge about lighting, by the method of discussion and technical literature reading to provide an opinion about lighting. The course are including green lighting for sustainable development, lighting and color, the evaluation of glare, the new tendency of lighting source, the beauty of luminair, lighting for venerable age, lighting for fire control, visual and luminance distribution, evaluation index and base of lighting energy, the advantage of daylight, lighting control, road lighting and safety, outdoor lighting and urban environment, lighting pollution.

notes: 職建都所與職創新所合開

description.zh: 深耕趨勢學理論，以生活型態資訊為基礎，探討社會趨勢與科技發展趨勢，做為商品企畫的基礎。本課程旨在引導學習者運用學術研究的工具，以科學的方法定義市場需求，並以理性的思維進行商品企畫。
description.en: Current theories and practices of trend study are covered, including trends of living style, fashion and technology development followed by product planning practice. The aims of this course is to put emphasis on conducting research approach in the process of scientific marketing management and reasonable product planning.

notes: ★設計博核心選修，設計博與創新碩合開

description.zh: 本課程在研習數位電視，此課程包含 EDTV HDTV，SDTV。其課程目的在給予學習者了解數位電視分析與設計，並強調基礎與應用知識以符合工業界的需求，課程內容可包括下列主題。1. 影像簡介， 2. 顏色空間， 3. 類比影像介面， 4. 數位影像介面， 5. 數位影像處理， 6. NTSC,  PAL, 和 SECAM 系統， 7. H.261 和 H.263， 8. MPEG， 9. 數位電視。
description.en: This course is concerned with the digital television (DTV) design, which includes Enhanced Definition Television (EDTV), High Definition Television (HDTV), Standard Definition Television (SDTV). Its purpose is to deal with the analysis and design of DTV system, emphasizing fundamentals as well as new paradigms that students need to master in today's industry. The course covers the following topics. 1. Introduction to Video; 2. Color space; 3. Analog video interfaces; 4. Digital Video Interfaces; 5. Digital Video Processing; 6. NTSC, PAL, and SECAM system; 7. H.261 and H.263; 8. MPEG ; 9. Digital Television (DTV).

notes: 電子所和電資外生合開

description.zh: 1. 微帶線 2. 散射參數 3. 介電材料 4. 共振器 5. 平行耦合線 6. 耦合器 7. 分配器 8. 平面濾波器 9. 平面天線
description.en: 1.Microstrip line2.Scattering parameters3.Dielectric materials4.Resonators5.Parallel coupled lines 6.Couplers7.Dividers 8.Planar Filters9. Planar antennas

notes: 電子所和電資外生合開

description.zh: 本課程在介紹電腦視覺的基本概念與使用技術。課程內容包含: 1.introduction to computer vision 2.geometric camera calibration 3.illumination 4.geometry of multiple view 5.structure from motion 6.segmentation by clustering 7.tracking models 8.model-based vision 9.image-based rendering.
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the basic concepts and techniques of computer vision. The outline of this course includes: 1.introduction to computer vision 2.geometric camera calibration 3.illumination 4.geometry of multiple view 5.structure from motion 6.segmentation by clustering 7.tracking models 8.model-based vision 9.image-based rendering.

notes: 資工所。創新 AI 和電資外生合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。本課程著重於 IC 製程技術之學習。課程內容包括：IC 絕緣技術、模組製程技術、導線技術、整合工程技術、SOC 技術及半導體奈米元件技術等。
description.en: A study on advanced IC process. The contents cover IC isolation technology, module process, interconnection line process, process integration, SOC applications and CMOS nano device engineering etc.

notes: 機電、製科、外生專班合開，限 40 人；製科◎、甲選修

description.zh: 數位電源為目前各大電源轉換電路公司研究的議題。本課程將介紹數位電源轉換器的動作模式、控制與實作考量，配合模擬軟體驗證理論，最後以數位電源設計實例進行探討。本課程藉由理論探討與模擬實作，加強學生的理論知識與實作能力。
description.en: Digital power supply design is a major industrial topic. This course introduces the operation and control of digital power converters, and discusses the design principles and their implementation considerations. Simulation is used to validate the theory learned in this course. Also, digital power supply design examples are discussed in detail. Students can strengthen their theoretical knowledge and practical ability through theoretical discussion and simulation practice from this course.

name.zh: 數位電源控制與電路設計
name.en: Digital Power Supply Control and Circuit Design

notes: 預選限 45 人

description.zh: 本課程將探討錯誤診斷系統理論與相關控制系統工程知識，將以馬達與鋰電池為例，實際應用錯誤診斷理論，並學習錯誤診斷的實現與應用技巧。本課程藉由理論推導與程式模擬實作，協助學生專精控制工程領域知識，並透過期刊文章研讀與討論，進一步加強學生創新思考與簡報專業論文之能力。
description.en: This course investigates fault diagnosis system algorithms and their relevant control system engineering knowledges. This course takes motors and lithium-ion batteries as examples to implement the fault diagnosis algorithms and to learn the implementation skills of fault diagnosis algorithms. The goal of this course is to improve students’ control engineering domain knowledge though algorithm derivation, coding and simulations; also, to enhance students’ innovative thinking capabilities and presentation skills through journal paper reviewing and discussions.

notes: 電機所和電資外生合開，預選限 25 人

description.zh: 由量子化學及結晶化學等理論為基礎，討論一些分析儀器的原理，構造及應用。特別是原子光譜法，電化學分析法及離子層析儀及質譜儀等，針對無機物之分析方法。
description.en: Considering the theories of quantum and crystal chemistry, discuss the theories, structure and applications of some instruments.  Those are used for chemical analysis, especially for inorganic materials: atomic spectroscopy, electrochemical analysis methods, ion-exchange chromatography and mass spectroscopy.

name.en: Special Topics of Instrumental Analytical Chemistry

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作，包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧，正確組織文章的各個片段，避免口語用字寫字的陋習，使所作之文章能掌握其涵意，亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Thesis Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

description.zh: 環境地質學是資源探採及地質工程的專業課程；透過環境地質的調查與研究，以了解自然資源之使用與工程相關之地質問題。內容包括：水、土壤、礦產資源、能源開發、認識地質作用對人類生存環境的影響、認識自然災害，瞭解人為破壞引起的災害、地質環境改變、人類衛生環境的影響及各種廢料處理等。並介紹環境地質圖、山崩潛感圖、土地利用潛力圖等環境地質學研究方法。
description.en: Environmental geology is a professional course of resource exploration, extraction and geological engineering; through investigation and study of the geological environment, in order to understand the use of natural resources and the engineering geological problems. The contents include: water, soil, mineral resources, energy development, understanding of the geological environment for human survival and understanding of natural disasters, understand the human damage caused by disasters, changes in the geological environment, the environmental impact of human health and the various waste processing. And introduce the environmental geology research method : environmental geological maps, landslide susceptibility map, land-use potential map.

description.zh: 電化學的領域包羅萬象，舉凡電泳作用與腐蝕現象的探討，電分析感測器或電池元件的製作，以及電鍍、拋光或鋁和氯氣的生產技術等均為電化學工程的範疇。本課程除了講述基本的電化學原理外，將著重於電化學分析方法在化學系統研究上的應用。
description.en: The field of electrochemistry includes many different phenomena (e.g., electrophoresis and corrosion), devices (electro analytical sensors and batteries), and technologies (the electroplating of metals and the large-scale production of aluminum and chlorine). In addition to an overview of the basic principles of electrochemistry, the main emphasis here is on the application of electrochemical methods to the study of chemical systems.

description.zh: 討論有機化學與環境、浮選及再生技術等方面有關的部份。主要在使用到的有機化學藥劑，如介面活性劑。
description.en: The organic chemicals, such as surfactants, which are used for environmental, floatation, and recycle techniques will be discussed in this course.

description.zh: 本課程介紹任務導向自主決策 AI 的概念與開發流程，涵蓋決策理論、強化學習、環境建模、多模態感知與策略優化，透過實作專案培養學生自主分析、設計與實現 AI 解決方案的能力。
description.en: This course introduces task-oriented autonomous decision-making AI concepts and development processes, covering decision theory, reinforcement learning, environment modeling, multimodal perception, and policy optimization. Through hands-on projects, students develop skills to analyze, design, and implement AI solutions independently.

notes: 機電所和製科所合開

description.zh: 1. 半導體: 5 種模組介紹 - 真空、機器手臂、射頻 / 電漿、真空吸盤 / 加熱體、氣體儀表盤 - 從理論到應用。8 種半導體機台介紹 Epi/RTP, Implant, MDP, DDP, Etch, CMP, PDC and ECD. 2. 期末海報展
description.en: 1.Semiconductor:5 Modules – Vacuum, Robot, Plasma/RF, Electric Static Chuck (ESC)/Heater and Gas Panel.8 Equipment - Epi/RTP, Implant, MDP, DDP, Etch, CMP, PDC and ECD.2.Factory Touring: Global Technical Learning Center (GTLC) Lab Touring at Hsinchu.3.Top Executive Sharing: Worthy Horng – Cust Services & Supt, VP of AMAT.4.Final Exam – Poster Exhibition.

notes: 機電所。製科所和半導體碩班合開，綜三演講廳

description.zh: 這門課程深入探討將 AI 技術直接整合至硬體的過程。課程從 AI 晶片的基本概念開始，進一步探討各種 AI 的數位、類比及混合訊號架構。課程內容涵蓋了對神經網路模型映射到晶片硬體的過程及優化。重要的一環是神經網路編譯器的設計與優化，並輔以實務工具和考量以實現高效的 AI 晶片設計。課程還探討了 AI 晶片的當前應用及 AI 硬體發展的未來趨勢。課程以學生專題為導向，將所學知識應用於創新的 AI 晶片解決方案。此課程旨在為學生提供在不斷進化的 AI 硬體領域中取得成功所需的技能和知識。
description.en: This course, titled "AI-on-Chip Design: Architectures and Applications," offers a deep dive into how AI technologies are integrated directly onto hardware. It begins with fundamental concepts of AI-on-Chip, moving into the intricacies of digital, analog, and mixed-signal architectures tailored for AI applications. The curriculum includes a thorough examination of neural network models, focusing on their optimization and the critical process of mapping these models onto hardware. A significant portion is dedicated to the design and optimization of neural network compilers, supplemented by practical insights into the tools and considerations necessary for efficient AI chip design. The course also explores current applications of AI-on-Chip and anticipates future trends that could reshape AI hardware development. It culminates in a project presentation where students apply what they've learned to create innovative AI-on-Chip solutions. This course equips students with the skills and knowl

name.zh: 人工智慧晶片設計與應用

description.zh: 有關建築歷史、理論、批評、構造、營建管理等相關主題討論。
description.en: A theme topic discussion on the field of architecture history, theory, criticism, structure, construction and management, etc.

notes: 建都所和建築四合開

description.zh: 本課程為線性代數的深化與廣化。以理論的深化而言，本課程由高斯消去法談起，解釋四個向量空間，進而說明矩陣的正交性與投影。接著，本課程闡述行列式、特徵值與特徵向量、矩陣的乘冪與指數、頻譜分解，最終收尾於奇異值分解，以此定理統整這一學期的所有內容。以應用的廣化而言，本課程在上述理論說明之外，還會特別介紹科學、工程的應用實例，例如迴歸分析、線性規劃、圖論與網路、主成份分析。
description.en: 1. Introduction - Importance of Linear Algebra2. Ax=b, Matrix, Gaussian Elimination and Application3. Vector Spaces and Linear Equation4. Applications: Graphs and Networks5. Orthogonality and Least Squares6. Applications: Multiple Regression7. Application: Linear Programming 8. Determinant and its Applications9. Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors10. Ak and Difference Equations11. eA and Differential Equations12. Similarity Transformation and Spectral Theorem13. Positive Definite Matrices and Minimum Principles14. Applications: Multivariate Analysis and Principal Component Analysis15. Singular Value Decomposition and its Applications

description.zh: 博士學位論文寫作
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis.

description.zh: 專題報告專題演講 研究小組討論
description.en: Case Study.Seminar.Group meeting.

notes: 博士班

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor.  The results should be written as a dissertation.

notes: 博士班必修

description.zh: 高分子流變學本課程以講述高分子流體之黏性及彈性為主。內容包括：(1) 黏彈性簡介 (2) 時間溫度轉換 (3) 非結晶區之玻璃轉移點 (4) 橡膠理論 (5) 黏彈模型 (6) 介電鬆弛等專題。
description.en: This course will extensively study the viscosity and elasticity of polymeric materials. The main contents include(1) Phenomenalogical Treatment of Viscoelasticity(2) Time-Temperature Correspondence(3) Transitions and Relaxation in Amorphous Polymers(4) Rubber Elasticity(5) Viscoelastic Models(6) Dielectric Relaxation

description.zh: 本課程介紹複合材料的原理，包括複合材料的高分子化學、複合材料的加工方法、複合材料的力學分析與設計、以及複合材料在高科技上的應用。加工方法包括真空袋成型法、壓力釜成形法、樹脂移送成型、編織法、纏繞成形法、拉擠成型法、模壓法… 等，本課程詳述這些加工方法的原理及應用，同時介紹力學分析及設計，應力和應變之關係，複材之彎曲、靜態和動態之強度、脫層、耐久性、及以力學觀點設計複合材料，最後討論複合材料如何應用於高科技及民生工業上。
description.en: This course is to elucidate the principle and potential application of composite materials. It includes polymer chemistry, design and analysis of composite, and processing methods. The composite processings include autoclaves,vacuum vags, resin transform molding, braiding, filament winding, pultrusions, sheet molding compound,…etc. The principles and application of the methods will be elucidated. The analysis and design, strain-stress relationships, extension and bending, static and dynamic strengths, and delamination, will also be discussed. Finally, the potential application of the composite in high-tech industries will be elucidated.

class.name: 能源光電外國學生專班

notes: 高分所和 EOMP 合開 / 新老師

description.zh: 課程從統計模式 (迴歸分析)、概率、再進入隨遇變數、概率分佈、分佈曲線種類、樣品分佈、統計評估及統計測試等核心。
description.en: The contents of this course are statistical modeling (regression analysis)、probability, random variables and probability distributions, important probability distribution in engineering, sampling  distributions, statistical estimation and statistical testing.

description.zh: 本課程將透過每週專題演講方式，讓學生了解有機材料之最新開發成品或最先進之研究成果。演講者之安排將以校外知名專家學者及校內各計畫執行者為主。
description.en: This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application on the organic materials. Speakers being invited are well-known scholars in organic area.  Graduate students or thesis advisors will also be invited to report any in interesting result from their graduate studies.

notes: 雙號選課 (新老師）

description.zh: 本課程以個案研究和文獻探討方式讓學生了解總體經濟的環境（包括 GDP、GNP、失業率、景氣循環、通貨膨脹、政府的財政政策和貨幣政策的規劃與制定、匯率制度、總合供給與需求等課題）。
description.en: This course is to analyze the macroeconomic policy, international economy, business cycles, government policy, exchange rate and other macroeconomic-related issues. The course will be taught with case studies and journal literature. Group discussions are needed.

notes: 經管所和 IMBA 合開 / 哈佛

description.zh: 本課程旨在使學生深入了解當前最新科技發展下各類顯示器之運作原理與技術趨勢，同時探討相關產業的發展動向。課程內容自色彩科學與工程基礎出發，系統性介紹薄膜電晶體 (TFT)、液晶顯示器 (LCD)、有機發光二極體 (OLED)、反射式顯示器、頭戴式 AR/VR 顯示器，以及觸控面板等相關顯示技術。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the operating principles and technological trends of modern display systems under the latest advancements in science and technology. It also explores the development and perspectives of the display industry. Starting from the fundamentals of color science and engineering, the course systematically introduces various display technologies, including thin-film transistors (TFT), liquid crystal displays (LCD), organic light-emitting diodes (OLED), reflective displays, headmounted AR/VR displays, and touch panels, enabling students to build a well-rounded knowledge base and insight into display technology applications.

name.en: Introduction to novel flat panel display technology

description.zh: 本課程介紹 OpenGL 與 OpenGL for Embedded Systems (OpenGL ES)。講授電腦圖學基本原理：幾何圖形、互動介面、幾何轉換、透視投影、明暗度計算、紋理貼圖、色彩原理等。接著介紹 3D 繪圖引擎、建模引擎、創作實例經驗談。修課學生必須熟悉 C 語言。課程並介紹近年來在多媒體產業應用非常多的擴增實境 (Augmented Reality, AR) 繪圖技術。本課訓練學生具備使用 OpenGL/OpenGL ES 程式庫、瞭解 3D 繪圖引擎、及運用擴增實境技術之能力，並能整合以上技術進行 3D 繪圖程式開發創作。
description.en: This course introduces 3D computer graphics. Topics include OpenGL, shading language, graphics pipeline, geometric, interactive interface, transformation, projection, hidden surfaces, shading, texture mapping, and color. This course introduces 3D rendering, modeling, and graphics engine. The student will be required to write computer programs using C language and OpenGL API. Topics of augmented reality (AR) will be covered in the class. The students will be able to develop 3D modeling, rendering, graphics, and augmented reality tools.

description.zh: 噪音基礎，噪音分析實驗法，汽車噪音法規與標準，基本噪音控制程序，車輛噪音與噪音控制基本，引擎噪音與控制，車輛噪音源，車輛噪音與改良，心理聲學與最佳化
description.en: Fundamentals of Acoustics, Experimental Methods of Acoustic Analysis, Automotive Noise Legislation and Standards, Basic Noise Control Procedure, Basics of Vehicle Noise and Noise Control, Engine Noise and Its Control, Vehicle Noise Sources, Vehicle Noise and Its Refinement, Psychoacoustic Analysis and Optimizations.

description.zh: 光電材料具備將光轉換為電能的能力，因此在當前的再生能源研究中中引起了廣泛與極大的關注。本課程著重介紹光電材料應用在光伏元件、發光二極體、光電感測器和薄膜電晶體。課程內容也包括半導體物理基礎知識、材料的分子結構、光吸收能力、載流子遷移率以及元件的穩定性和衰退的探討。
description.en: Optoelectronic materials have attracted much attention on a wide range of applications in renewable energy systems due to their ability to convert light into electricity. This course focus on introducing optoelectronic materials utilized in such kind of devices, photovoltaics, light-emitting diodes, photodetectors, and thin-film-transistors. This course also includes the fundamentals of semiconductor physics, materials’ molecular structures, light absorption capacity, carrier mobility and device’s stability and degradation.

name.zh: 光電材料於再生能源之應用
name.en: Optoelectronic Materials in Renewable Energy Applications

description.zh: 本課程旨在探索人工智能機器人對城市發展的正面影響。學生將掌握機器人技術的基礎，並通過實作、實驗與團隊合作，定義都市所面臨的挑戰並設計出解決方案的機器人原型，並學會如何運用所學知識解決實際問題。
description.en: This course is designed to delve into the transformative role of artificial intelligence (AI) robots in shaping the future of urban development. Participants will gain foundational knowledge in robotics, engaging in hands-on projects, experiments, and collaborative efforts to pinpoint and tackle urban challenges. Through the creation of robotic prototypes, students will not only devise innovative solutions but also learn the practical application of their theoretical knowledge to real-world problems. This curriculum encourages a deep understanding of how AI can contribute positively to urban environments, equipping students with the skills to make impactful changes in the field of urban development.

notes: 先鋒 1 樓 城市科學實驗室

description.zh: 介紹各種產能反應的原子分子層級理論，包括燃燒、氫生成反應、氧還原反應、二氧化碳還原反應，和電化學電池、燃料電池，新能源材料等物理化學反應程序，以及低碳應用。
description.en: This course introduces reactions of energy production in the insight of atomic and molecular scale, including combustion, hydrogen evolution reaction, oxygen reduction reaction, carbon dioxide reduction reaction, and physiochemical mechanisms of electrochemical cells, fuel cells, new energy materials, and low-carbon applications.

notes: 新進教師 - 張老師

description.zh: 進、排氣系統與空氣動力學，排放物與燃燒現象，循環模擬與分析，引擎性能調諧及控制，引擎噪音源與控制。
description.en: Gas Dynamics in Intake and Exhaust Manifold, Emissions and Related Combustion Phenomena, Cycle-Simulation and Analysis, Engine Performance Tuning and Control, Engine Noise Source and Its Control.

name.en: Special Topics on Internal Combustion Engines

notes: 新進教師 - 黃老師

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意包括 10 個數值問題 1. 簡單熱傳導 2. 穩態圓柱熱傳問題 3. 完全展開管流 4. 翼片對流展開管流 5. 理想流體 6. 突然膨脹壓縮流 7. 自由對流完全展開流 8. 軸對稱流 9. 無限反應燃燒流場 10. 亂流流場
description.en: Including ten problems1. Simple pure conduction problem2. cylindrical conduction for steady non uniform k3. fully develop duct4. fin conduction convection for fully develop5. ideal flow6. sudden expansion compressible7. Free convective flow for fully develop8. Axial symmetry flow9. Infinitely combustion reaction10. Turbulent flow

notes: 1 週【停開】

description.zh: 本課程主要教授與土木有關之法規，諸如建築法、建築技術規則、都市計劃法、採購法、環保法規、水利法等，併借相關案例之分析研究，訓練學生土木法規之知識與能力。
description.en: The course is dive lessons on code of building , rule of construction technology ,stock up code ,code of environmental protection etc.

name.en: Legal Affairs and Dispute resolution in Construction

description.zh: 基本或然率，可靠度概念與定義，不確定性分析，可靠度分析之方法，可靠度導向設計，系統可靠度。
description.en: The analyses of structure reliability   Basic,the concept and definition of reliability uncertain analyses, the method of reliable analyses , reliability -orient design , system reliability.

notes: 土木 205

description.zh: 以結構工程、大地工程、防災科學、運輸交通、營建管理、營建材料及營建技術為專題討論主題之主要範疇。
description.en: Seminar Special subject discussion of structure engineering , geography engineering pretecting calamity science, transportation, construction management , construction material and construction technique.

notes: 碩一丙丁戊組 / 土木 500

description.zh: 認識科技文章及科技學術論文語法、文體、結構組織等特質，並探討技術報告及論文撰寫方式。
description.en: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on technology and technical writings are concerned. Discussions include specific ways to technical presentation and technical writings.

notes: 上限 15 人

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹領導與組織管理的理論與實務。課程目的有四個：(1) 了解組織領導與管理的內涵；(2) 討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3) 對實務界人士提供具體建議；(4) 將領導與管理的技巧應用到生活面。
description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is; (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for business management and (4) to apply the basic ideas of leadership and management in daily life.

description.zh: 課程兩個主要目標為光譜學方法及分離方法。光譜學方法內容含紫外、可見、紅光、核磁、x-ray 等光譜法。電子譜及質譜也將被討論。分離方法方面有液層、氣層、膠層等層析法。分離後串聯之光譜分析也會學習。
description.en: Two major goals of this course are spectroscopy and separation methods. Spectroscopy methods include ultraviolet, visible, infrared, nuclear magnetic, and x-ray spectroscopies.Election and mass spectrometry are also included. Separation methods are: gas, liquid, and gel chromatographies. In addition, GC-MS,LC-MS, GC-IR, etc. will be studied.

description.zh: 隨著網際網路的迅速發展，網路電子商務已經成為傳統行銷通路以外的一個新興通路。再加上網路全年無休、成本低廉、以全球為市場的優勢，以及可符合消費者的需求的特色，使得電子商務明顯的成為未來商業發展的主流，因此國外廠商紛紛上網卡位，網路商業化已成為一股不可抵擋的趨勢。本課程中將介紹對電子商務作理論與實務上的探討。1. 電子商務與商業模式 2. 電子商務策略發展 3. B to C 電子商務 4. C to C 電子商務 5. B to B 電子商務 6. 無線網路 7. 企業電子化 8. 企業資源規劃 9. 供應鏈管理 10. 顧客關係管理 11 知識管理與 e-Learning12. 網路行銷 14. 網路廣告與關鍵字廣告 15. 網路安全性
description.en: E-business (electronic business) is the conducting of business on the Internet, not only buying and selling but also servicing customers and collaborating with business partners.The outline of electronic business is as following:1. Introduction to Electronic Commerce.2. Technology Infrastructure: The Internet and the World Wide Web.3. Selling on the Web: Revenue Models and Building a Web Presence.4. Marketing on the Web.5. Business-to-Business Online Strategies6. Online Auctions, Virtual Communities, and Web Portals.7. The Environment of Electronic Commerce: Legal, Ethical, and Tax Issues.8. Web Server Hardware and Software.9: Electronic Commerce Software.10. Electronic Commerce Security.11. Payment Systems for Electronic Commerce.12. Planning for Electronic Commerce

description.zh: 使電腦系統具有解決問題的能力、智慧的表現及儲存的型態、理解及辨識的能力、及視覺、聽覺、觸覺及表達的能力、並有學習、認知、分析理解等能力。
description.en: Made computer the power of problem solving, intelligent behavior and storage type, comprehension and distinguish abilities. The abilities of vision, hearing, touching, learning, identifying, analyzing are also the target of the course.

notes: 工管所和管理博合開

description.zh: 超快雷射由於其脈衝寬度在皮秒 (10-12) 之下，它在軍事科技、工業應用、生醫檢測與學術研究所扮演的角色日益重要，本課程將介紹超短脈衝雷射的種類，尤其著重在光纖短脈衝雷產生的原理、脈衝壓縮的技術與超短脈衝寬度與相位量測的技術，此外也將介紹超快雷射的各種應用包括光譜量測、泵 - 探量測與非線性光學量測等技術。
description.en: Due to relative short pulse below one picosecond, ultrafast lasers have been widely used in various fields including military, industry, biomedical diagnosis and scientific research.  In this course, it will introduce various kinds of the ultrafast lases, especially on the principle of mode-locked fiber generation, pulse compression technique and the method of the ultrashort pulsewidth measurement as well as phase retrieval.  Various applications of ultrafast laser including fluorescence, pump-probe and nonlinear optical measurement have also been introduced in this course.

description.zh: 課程內容包括：原理探討：超音波，磁場與磁性，電磁感應與渦電流，輻射線，液體表面現象，材料微結構；方法介紹：磁場檢測法，超音波檢測法，渦電流檢測法，X 光檢測法，液滲法，微奈米檢測 (各種顯微鏡) 等；材料非破壞檢測實驗：導電性材料、磁性材料、陶瓷材料、複合材料之缺陷檢測；結構非破壞檢測實驗：機械零件、以及特定結構之檢測；非破壞檢測影像：電腦數據擷取、數據分析、與影像處理
description.en: Introduce the concepts of following topics, Fundamentals: ultrasonic waves, magnetic field and magnetism, electromagnetic induction and eddy currents, X-rays, penetrants. NDT methods: ultrasonic testing, magnetoscopic inspections, eddy current testing, radiographic technique, penetrants method. NDT of materials: conductive materials, magnetic materials, ceramics, composite materials. NDT of structures: mechanical components, specific structures. NDT images: PC-based data acquisition, data analysis and image process.

name.zh: 材料與結構非破壞檢測
name.en: Non-Destructive Testing of Materials and Structures

notes: 限 15 人

description.zh: （一）瞭解人力資源發展之定義、內涵與功能；（二）培養進行人力資源發展之基本能力。課程內容包括：人力資源發展之定義與內涵、人力資源發展之需求評估、人力資源規劃、學習理論、訓練方法、教材編撰、訓練發展評量及國際化人力資源發展等。課程實施方法為講解、討論、參觀訪問及專題討論。
description.en: The course aims to (1) understand the definition, essence, and function of human resources development, (2) cultivate the fundamental capability of human resource development. It covers the definition and essence of human resources development, demand evaluation of human resource development, planning of human resource, learning theories, training method; curriculum designing and compilation, evaluation of training development, and international human resource development. The course is conducted through lectures, discussions, field trip activities, and colloquia.

notes: 上限 10 人，優先開放給職碩二未選過人資核心課程的同學

description.zh: 中文概述：專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case study. Seminar. Group meeting.

notes: 碩一

description.zh: 課程主要內容介紹自動化科技之基礎知識與先進應用技術，並側重在自動化科技相關之專業知識。
description.en: This course introduces the fundamental theories and advanced technologies in the field of automatic and advanced technologies. The topics covered mainly in the areas of automation technologies, and related research areas.

description.zh: 讀書報告、專題討論、製造科技相關技術及產品介紹與討論、Seminar 心得等，可重覆修習。
description.en: Case Study, Workshop, Group discussion, Seminars, Manufacturing Technology in Modern Industries.

notes: 綜二演講廳，博士班必修

description.zh: 設計方法，材料性質，構件受壓行為，構件受拉行為，構件受撓行為，軸力和彎矩之聯合作用，構件受剪行為，構件受扭行為。
description.en: Behavior of Reinforced Concrete Frame   1.Method of Design2.Properties of Materials3.Compressed Behavior of Frame4.Tension Behavior of Frame5.Flexing Behavior of Frame6.Impact of Axial Force And Moment7.Shear Behavior of Frame8.Torsion Behavior of Frame

name.zh: 鋼筋混凝土構件行為學

notes: 土木 505

description.zh: 物件導向程式設計以類別與物件為核心概念，輔以靜態的屬性及動態的方法，能夠直覺並且系統化地描述真實世界的事物，再輔以封裝、繼承、多型、介面等機制，能夠有效率地達到程式碼的共享及再利用，因此物件導向程式設計的功能不但被各式各樣的程式語言所廣泛支援，亦已形成了一門獨立的學問。而資料庫是重要、普遍且實用的資訊管理核心技術。但在另一方面，資料庫的開發與實作過程對於理解物件導向程式設計更是一個良好的契機與範例。本課程將以土木營建領域的範例出發，教導修課同學開發輔助工程資訊管理之資料庫系統，並在資料的分析處理及使用者介面的實作上導入物件導向程式設計的概念。
description.en: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm based on the concept of class and objects. With properties and methods that can describe the features of classes, a programmer can model the real world objects in an systematical way. In addition, the three important mechanisms of OOP, which are encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism, also enable a programmer to reuse and share their code easily and efficiently. Base on the Architecture/Engineering/Construction applications, this course aims to train the enrolled student for developing the basic OOP concepts, analyzing the database schemas, as well as implementing the OOP skills on information systems developments.

name.zh: 物件導向程式設計與資料庫應用

notes: 土木 106

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹強化學習（Reinforcement Learning, RL）的核心概念、數學基礎與主要演算法，並結合財務與投資管理的應用實例。內容涵蓋馬可夫決策過程（MDP）、動態規劃（DP）、蒙地卡羅（MC）方法、時序差分（TD）學習、策略梯度（Policy Gradient）、深度強化學習等主題，同時透過金融市場的真實案例，引導學生理解 RL 在投資組合最佳化、資產配置、避險策略、交易策略自動化等領域中的應用方式。課程採用理論與實作並重的方式，搭配 Python 程式實作與金融資料分析，協助學生逐步累積建構 RL 模型的能力。學生將學習如何定義財務問題中的狀態空間、動作空間與報酬函數，並訓練智能代理人於市場模擬環境中進行策略學習、決策與改善。本課程亦將討論強化學習在金融應用上的挑戰，例如市場隨機性、風險控管、環境非平穩性、評估困難等問題，並介紹最新的研究方向與業界實務。修讀本課程後，學生能具備基礎的強化學習能力，了解 RL 模型在 FinTech、量化投資與數位財務決策上的角色，並能在課堂專題中打造具體的 RL 金融應用原型。
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Reinforcement Learning (RL) and its applications in finance. Topics include Markov Decision Processes (MDP), Dynamic Programming, Monte Carlo methods, Temporal-Difference learning, Policy Gradient approaches, and Deep Reinforcement Learning. Through lectures and coding exercises, students will learn how to formulate financial problems within the RL framework—defining states, actions, and reward functions—and how to train agents to make sequential investment decisions.The course integrates theory with practical applications such as portfolio optimization, asset allocation, hedging strategies, and algorithmic trading. Students will gain hands-on experience implementing RL algorithms in Python and applying them to real-world financial datasets. Challenges unique to financial markets, including stochasticity, risk constraints, non-stationarity, and evaluation difficulties, will also be discussed.

name.en: Foundations of Reinforcement Learning with Applications in Finance

notes: 新聘專任教師

description.zh: 此課程在介紹 Optimal Control 的理論基礎與其應用﹐範圍從古典的早期發展到最新的進展都包括在內，其目的在使同學能具有最佳控制器設計能力。 內容包括：最佳化問題求解、線性二次調整器設計、線性二次高斯觀測器設計。此外，現代控制中常用的 loop shaping 及 loop transfer recovery 技術亦將在課程中介紹。預修課程 ： 線性控制系統 (可同時修)、工程數學
description.en: 1.	Introduction.2.	Mathematical preliminaries for optimal control.3.	Classical linear quadratic optimal control, including regulation & tracking control.4.	Observer based optimal control (LQG control). 5.	Loop shaping and LTR control.  This is a course designed for graduate students which will provide techniques that can help you to design an optimal controller for linear systems with a specific performance index. Concepts such as optimality condition, linear quadratic regulation (LQR), and linear quadratic gaussian (LQG) problem are introduced in the course. In addition, the course also includes the loop shaping concept and the loop transfer recovery (LTR) technique which are frequently used in the modern control.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹大數據分析緣起與理論基礎，大數據分析與企業經營間之獲利關聯，並輔以大數據分析案例讓學員對於大數據應用有更深層的認識與啟發。
description.en: The big data opportunity, extracting insight from an immense volume, variety and velocity of data, in context, beyond what was previously possible, will be addressed in this course. Applications for big data analytics could include smarter healthcare, multi-channel, finance, computer log analysis, homeland security, traffic control, telecom, search quality, manufacturing, trading analytics, fraud and risk, retailing, among others.

name.en: Big Data Analytics and Industrial Applications

notes: (群組 7) 資訊管理 (關聯群 3)

description.zh: 本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。目的二，進一步教授 ESG 及聯合國 SDGs 指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。最後，透過對於 ESG 與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

notes: 工管碩、博和管理博合開，博士班請選此課號

description.zh: 本課程主要邀請學術界或企業界的學者專家，從理論或實務的角度，經由演講介紹近代的服務與科技管理專題，促使學生更深入及廣面瞭解管理現狀或趨勢。
description.en: This seminar course invites guest speakers from well known companies to share their experiences of service and technology management and provide students the updated practices and management trends in the field.

notes: 管理博和工管博合開

description.zh: 自由度、(平面與空間) 運動幾何分析、彈簧、避震器、力傳遞分析、撓性、電腦輔助懸吊系統分析與設計。
description.en: Degree of Freedom, (2D and 3D) Kinematic Analysis, Springs, Dampers, Force Analysis, Compliance, Computer Aided Analysis and Design of Suspension Systems.

description.zh: 本課程將以車輛之傳動系統設計與分析為主要內容，傳動系統之定義為從動力源至驅動輪間之各項組合，其中包括離合器、加力箱、變速箱、差速箱、傳動軸與最終傳動等組合，由於每種車輛行車特性之不同，因此前述之各項組合有不同之排列方式，傳動系統設計之優劣往往影響到車輛之行車性能。本課程將從車輛行駛阻力推演出傳統系統設計之理念及方法，並針對如何發揮動力源之最佳特性，搭配良好之傳動系統設計以達到較佳之行車性能為主要教學之目的。
description.en: Introduction to the vehicle drive-train design and analysis. Topics include definition for drive-train system、clutches、transfer case、manual transmission、automatic transmission、differential gear、transmission shaft  and final driver.  Fundamentals of vehicle tractive resistance will deduce the methodology of drive-train design.  The good drive-train design will result in optimal vehicle tractive performance.

description.zh: 以結構工程、大地工程、防災科學、運輸交通、營建管理、營建材料及營建技術為專題討論主題之主要範疇。
description.en: SeminarSpecial subject discussion of structure engineering , geography engineering pretecting calamity science, transportation, construction management , construction material and construction technique.

notes: 碩二甲乙組 / 土木 500

description.zh: 以結構工程、大地工程、防災科學、運輸交通、營建管理、營建材料及營建技術為專題討論主題之主要範疇。
description.en: SeminarSpecial subject discussion of structure engineering , geography engineering pretecting calamity science, transportation, construction management , construction material and construction technique.

notes: 碩二丙丁戊組 / 土木 500

description.zh: 本課程之開設旨再協助學生了解質化研究典範之特質，熟悉質化訪談的相關技巧與資料分析之方法。其內容包括：質化研究之特質 、研究設計與樣本選擇、質化研究之信度、效度與研究倫理、質化訪談法與訪談經驗分享、資料分析之技巧、質化研究實例介紹，以及質化研究之寫作。
description.en: The course is designed to make a brief introduction about qualitative research. The contents include: (a) the characteristics of qualitative research ; (b)  its research design and sampling; (c) the validity, reliability and ethics; (d) the techniques  of qualitative research; and(e) the writing and evaluation of qualitative research  proposal and thesis.

notes: 開學第一周上課未出席不得加選

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究 ，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis.

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

name.zh: 創業 0 到 2 的思維與實作

description.zh: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。
description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

name.zh: 企業最愛：高質感簡報溝通力
name.en: Corporate's Favorite: High-quality Communication and Presentation Ability

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生創新創業的實務，讓學生實際組成團隊進行創業，並有老師全程指導實踐創業，學校並提供基本創業基金與創業場地，輔導學生實際體會創業的過程。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、經營模式建立、創業財務、創業專題進行、創業競賽等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students to practice the entrepreneurship and innovation. Students will form an entrepreneurship team. Teacher will guide the students throughout the entrepreneurship processes. University will offer students initial funds and incubation assistances. Students will gain practical experiences on how to establish entrepreneurship. The contents include entrepreneurial thoughts and actions, design thinking, self-understanding, team formation, business model development, entrepreneurship finance, entrepreneurship practices, entrepreneurship contests, and so on.

description.zh: 本校為強化學生的就業能力，加強學生的職場競爭力，開設「職涯講座課程」，藉由業界主管與人員介紹不同種類的工作模式，如派遣、公職、舒活族、獵人頭公司、國外企業等，提升學生對於國內外職場的認識，並進一步提升學生的就業率與競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance student’s competitive ability in the workplace. The course contents include tips of interview, self-marketing in the workplace and the planning of the career life etc. By the topics, students will be equipped with a variety of presentation skills that needed in the workplace to raise the employment rate.

notes: 六週密集授課，星期三 789 節課程。

description.zh: 本課程授課主要內容分為三部分：第一部份為都市防災概論，此部分主要針對國內外文獻作一回顧，進而瞭解都市防災整體架構，區分為（1）文獻回顧；（2）防災基本計畫；及（3）防災整體架構等。期使國內都市計畫能逐步邁向防災都市計畫，以建立『安全都市』為目標。此部分的主要內容區分為：（1）都市災害風險理念的形成；（2）防災都市計畫與地區防災系統規劃；（3）都市計畫防災系統規劃原則；（4）都市計畫防災作業準則內容架構；（5）都市計畫防災作業準則；（6）安心都市計畫的形成與實現。第三部分為實務操作部分，以草屯鎮為例，藉九二一大地震的實例，深入探討災情調查的方法，實際調查狀況及研訂災後重建的程序與計畫內容，期望成為國內都市重建計畫的範例，主要內容區分為：（1）緒論；（2）重建理論；（3）草屯鎮現況發展；（4）災情調查方法與重建程序之建立；（5）災情調查分析與重建計畫內容研訂等。
description.en: The subject will be presented in three partsPart One - (1) Literature retrospection; (2) Fundamental planning for disaster prevention; (3) An integrated disaster prevention organization.Part Two -The major contents to be addressed include (1) Formation of urban disaster cataclysm and risk; (2) Urban disaster prevention plan and regional disaster protection system planning; (3) Principles for planning disaster prevention system in urban plan; (4) Operational standards and organization for urban disaster prevention; (5) Operational guidelines for urban disaster prevention; (6) Realization and formation of trouble free urban plan.Party Three -. The major contents are (1) Introduction; (2) rehabilitation theory; (3) Current development in Tsaotun City; (4) Establishment of damage survey method and rehabilitation procedures; (5) Detail analysis of damage survey report and preparation of rehabilitation plan content.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為培養學生將點子成功轉化為可行性募資提案，以柏克萊新創加速營模式，培養學生新創募資相關知識及提案簡報技能。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、顧客導向產品設計、提案規劃、簡報表達、募資、行銷、創業相關法律知識等。
description.en: The primary goal of this course is to equip students with the ability to successfully transform ideas into feasible crowdfunding proposals. Using the Berkeley startup accelerator model, the course helps students develop knowledge related to startup fundraising and presentation skills for proposals. Course content includes topics such as entrepreneurial spirit, innovative thinking, self-awareness, team formation, customer-oriented product design, proposal planning, presentation skills, fundraising, marketing, and legal knowledge related to entrepreneurship.

name.zh: 矽谷新創都在用的一分鐘電梯簡報
name.en: One-minute elevator pitches used by startups in Silicon Valley

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

notes: 六週密集授課、科技大樓國際會議廳。

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹統計分析方法於營建管理之應用，協助學生培養數據導向思維，以提升專案決策與管理效能。課程內容涵蓋問卷調查設計與信效度分析、變異數分析、複迴歸分析、因素分析及品管七大手法，並配合統計軟體進行資料處理與分析。透過案例研討與實務操作，學生將具備辨識與解決營建管理問題的能力，進而強化專案規劃、執行與控制之專業素養。
description.en: This course introduces the application of statistical analysis methods in construction management, aiming to cultivate students’ data-driven thinking and enhance their project decision-making and management effectiveness. The course covers survey design and reliability/validity analysis, analysis of variance (ANOVA), multiple regression analysis, factor analysis, and the seven quality control tools. Statistical software will be used for data processing and analysis. Through case studies and practical exercises, students will develop the ability to identify and solve problems in construction management, thereby strengthening their professional competence in project planning, execution, and control.

name.zh: 統計在營建管理之應用
name.en: Applications of Statistics in Construction Management

notes: 土木 201

description.zh: 隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各 20 位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 本課程介紹生成式人工智慧（AI）的基本概念與應用，包括生成式 AI 模型（如生成對抗網路、變分自編碼器、擴散模型、Transformer 模型等）和在語言生成、多媒體生成、行為生成及創作等方面的應用。同時涉及流程管理、AI 代理人以及在蛋白質設計和化學合成中的應用。學生將學習提示工程（Prompt Engineering）、辦公室流程自動化（RPA）、大型語言模型（LLM）、LangChain 技術及其應用、以及 RAG 檢索式增強生成的基本概念與實踐。透過使用軟體機器人來執行重複性任務，可以減少錯誤、節省時間、降低成本、提升生產力並優化辦公室流程，使機器人能更準確地執行指定任務並加速語言相關工作。課程將詳細介紹包括基本工具的使用、資料處理及企業案例實作。透過本課程，學生將具備使用生成式 AI 技術解決實際問題的能力，並理解 AI 在各行業中的應用與挑戰。除了文字生成，生成式 AI 在蛋白質設計和化學合成領域，通過深度學習生成新型蛋白質結構和化學化合物，推動醫藥研發和材料科學的創新。此技術也廣泛應用於虛擬角色創建、智慧城市規劃、環境模擬和自動駕駛等領域。
description.en: This course covers the basics and applications of generative AI, includingmodels like GANs, VAEs, Diffusion Models, and Transformers. It explores AIapplications in language generation, multimedia creation, and protein design.Students will learn about Prompt Engineering, RPA, Large Language Models,LangChain technology, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Thecourse emphasizes using AI to automate tasks, enhance productivity, andoptimize office processes. It also includes practical tools, data handling, andbusiness case implementation. Students will understand AI applications andchallenges across various industries, including pharmaceutical research, virtualcharacters, and smart cities.

description.zh: 研究生須要具有整合、分析資料與創新思維、寫作能力以完成碩博士論文。本課程主要包括：一、 良好研究特質，二、 研究規劃， 三、學習方法， 四、 創新思維方法 五、 寫作方法， 六、 簡報方法， 七、 研究實務練習
description.en: Graduate students need to integrate information and innovative insights to successfully achieve a master or Ph.D degree. The course includes: 1. Characteristics of good researchers. 2. Research planning. 3. Learning method. 4. Innovative thinking. 5. Writing method. 6. Present method. 7. Research design practice

description.zh: 本課程運用問題分析能力，以企業實際問題為基礎，採用問題導向學習（PBL）模式，進行人工智慧跨域專題實作。課程的目的是幫助學生理解如何運用人工智慧技術來解決現實世界中的問題。透過學習機器學習、光學檢測、影像辨識、生成式 AI、自然語言處理等 AI 技術，學生將能跨域應用這些知識於數據分析、高速通訊、資訊安全、專案管理、企業管理與決策、金融商業服務、智慧製造、無人載具、國防太空、智慧農業、醫療、法律、半導體、藝術創作、環境監測等領域。本課程將培養學生實際操作人工智慧的能力，提升其問題解決和創新思維，並培育具有創業和創新精神的人才，讓學生了解在 AI 轉型和導入過程中產業所面臨的挑戰與困難。
description.en: This course uses a problem-based learning (PBL) approach to tackle real-world business issues, guiding students through interdisciplinary AI projects. Itaims to teach students how to apply AI technologies such as machine learning,image recognition, and natural language processing across various domainslike data analysis, healthcare, and smart manufacturing. Students will gainpractical skills, enhance problem-solving abilities, and develop innovativethinking. The course prepares students to handle AI projects, understandindustry challenges, and cultivate entrepreneurial and innovative spirits.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨領域專題實作
name.en: Interdisciplinary Project in Artificial Intelligence Applications

description.zh: 該課程強調關鍵的經濟和商業概念（包括對需求和供應，生產，成本和利潤的分析；市場支配力；戰略行為和定價；國際貿易理論）影響決策。
description.en: The course emphasizes key economic and business concepts(including analysis of demand and supply, production, cost, and profit; market power, strategic behavior, and pricing; international trade theories) that influence decisions.

description.zh: 本課程在介紹如何運用企業內與員工之有關資源，包括其能力、知識、技術、態度和激勵，以配合企業整體競爭策略與形式。其內容有：人力資源分析、策略及目標、支援性作業之取得、發展及報酬、人力資源的維護。
description.en: This course introduce how to apply the resource of the inter-corporation and employee, such as capacity, knowledge, technology, attitude and incentive, in order to cooperate business integrate competitive strategy.

description.en: The course introduces monitoring and analysis for environment pollutants. It focuses the micro quantity analysis based on chemical theory. Modern instruments with high sensitivity will be also discussed.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹高科技產業（含半導體、面板、生技與精密製造）廠房之設施管理原理與實務，涵蓋潔淨室、HVAC（暖通空調）系統、超純水與化學品供應、氣體與電力公用設施、能源效率與碳管理，以及安全與韌性設計等關鍵領域。
description.en: This course introduces the principles and practices of facility management for high-tech industries, including semiconductor, display, biotechnology, and precision manufacturing plants. It covers key areas such as cleanrooms, HVAC systems, ultrapure water and chemical supply, gas and electrical utilities, energy efficiency and carbon management, as well as safety and resilience design.

description.zh: 本課程旨在講授互動式廣告的規劃與製作原理，包括互動式媒體的特性、廣告製作可如何掌握、發揮互動式媒體的特性，以及建置、設計、發展、與維護互動式廣告所需的相關概念、科技與技能。本課程亦教導同學如何應用電腦影像（computer imaging）與多媒體的科技與技術，來製作互動式廣告。
description.en: This course is mainly about the planning and principles of interactive advertisement production such as features of interactive media, how can advertisement production control and develop the features of interactive media, as well as the related concepts, technology, and skills needed in order to build, design, develop, and maintain interactive advertisement. Students will learn how to use computer imaging and the technology and techniques of multi-media to make an interactive advertisement.

description.zh: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行 "系統化創新" 是企業不可或缺的競爭策略及唯一的生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地應用。本課程以 TRIZ 創新方法為基礎，詳細的介紹系統性創新理論及實務的解題手法及落實創新方法之實務應用，可以很有系統地帶領學生們拓展革新思維，有效及系統化之應用於各種產業。讓學生也有機會應用於生活問題的解決。
description.en: Nowadays, enterprises in the phase of violating competence and decreasing profit. To make it survival, enterprises need to implement a systematic innovation technique, but only few companies really understanding and implement. The aim of this course is based on the applications of TRIZ creative method in detail which including the theory of systematic innovation and application, and also leading students to learn how the TRIZ works, and practice to solve their real life and various industries problems.

name.en: The applications of TRIZ creative method

notes: 工管四甲乙、工管所合開

description.zh: 總課程目標：在學員原有專業基礎上，增加其深度與廣度，包含自實質與非實質環境之探討與實踐等之能力。課程目標：透過設計課題培養自實質至非實質環境與實踐之總體操作能力，其深度與廣度將是評價判準。課程概要：就各學員所選定課題完成一系列設計成果及完整探討與實踐之過程書面資料，以接受目標檢驗。
description.en: Overall course objectives: To increase the depth and breadth of students’ existing professional foundation, including the ability to explore and practice in both physical and non-physical environments. Course Objective: To develop overall operational capabilities from physical to non-physical environments and practices through design projects. The depth and breadth of the design will be the criteria for evaluation. Course Overview: Each student will complete a series of design outcome and written materials on the complete discussion and practice process for the selected topic to be tested.

description.zh: 本課程介紹企業整合年度經營策略與財務規劃，並指導同學編製營業、生產、財務等完整預算體系，掌握各部門預算協調、預算控制方法，如彈性預算以及績效評估與差異分析實務，使大家能運用關鍵績效指標有效監控企業經營目標。
description.en: This course introduces the integration of annual business strategies and financial planning for enterprises, and guides students in developing a complete budget system for sales, production, and finance. Students will master methods for coordinating and controlling budgets across departments, such as flexible budgeting, and practical skills in performance evaluation and variance analysis, enabling them to effectively monitor business objectives using key performance indicators.

description.zh: 本課程旨在結合理論與實務，深入探究比特幣區塊鏈的核心技術、在傳統金融以及去中心化金融（DeFi）的創新應用。課程分成三大主軸：1. 技術基礎：深入解析比特幣的核心技術架構，包括共識機制、加密算法、去中心化網絡等關鍵技術原理；2. 金融生態：探討比特幣在傳統金融與去中心化金融中的創新應用，分析其對現有金融體系的潛在衝擊。結合理論與實務，研究區塊鏈技術在跨境支付、實體資產代幣化（Real World Asset Tokenization）等領域的具體應用案例；3. 專題實作：通過專題實作模組，學生將運用所學設計並開發基於比特幣區塊鏈或 DeFi 的創新應用，從需求分析、技術設計到實際開發，完成一個具實用價值的專案。專題成果將通過展示與技術審查檢視，並輔以市場分析與報告撰寫，提升學生的實務能力與創新思維。本課程不僅幫助學生掌握比特幣區塊鏈與去中心化金融的理論與技術，還著重於培養解決問題的能力，並為學生在區塊鏈與數位資產領域的職業發展奠定堅實基礎。
description.en: This course integrates theory and practice to examine Bitcoin blockchain technology and its applications in traditional finance and decentralized finance (DeFi). It introduces Bitcoin’s core architecture, including consensus mechanisms, cryptography, and decentralized networks, and explores use cases such as cross-border payments and real-world asset tokenization. Through project-based learning, students design and implement Bitcoin- or DeFi-based applications. Assessment includes technical reviews, presentations, and analytical reports, preparing students for careers in blockchain and digital asset ecosystems.

name.zh: 比特幣系統與去中心化金融專題
name.en: Bitcoin System and Decentralized Finance Projects

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期、或寒假 (可跨學期) 至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之校外研發機構的實務研究總累計時數不得低於 320 小時 (於 (跨) 學期中、暑期、或寒假期間)，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究心得報告予指導教授，指導教師依據研究生之實務研發紀錄及心得報告，指導研究生撰寫成實務研究成果報告，彙交所屬系所保存，並作為成績核定之依據。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占 50%，研究生指導教授占 50%，各系所得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the regular semester term or the summer/winter break, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The students are urged to take an active part in the training programs as well as observe and emulate the genuine research and development operations in respective manufacturers. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours (during the regular semester term and/or the summer/winter break). After the students finish the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site.

description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents - which will thus be collected and deposited in the individual departmental or graduate institute office. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organizations or agencies (50%), respectively.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期或寒假至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之同一校外研發機構的累計研究時數不得低於 320 小時，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究報告予指導教授，指導教師依據研究生之實務研發紀錄及心得報告，指導研究生撰寫成實務研究成果報告，彙交所屬系所保存，並作為成績核定之依據。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占 50%，研究生指導教授占 50%。
